researcher.sentenceEn: The researchers examined 207 genomes from modern donkeys living in 31 countries across the globe.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员对来自全球 31 个国家和地区的 207 份现代家驴基因组进行了研究。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: Researchers say these findings could help put donkeys in the spotlight.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员表示，这些发现有助于让驴受到大众的关注。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: Now, researchers have used genomes of over 200 donkeys to trace their domestication back to a single event around 7,000 years ago in East Africa — about 3,000 years before humans tamed horses.
researcher.translationZh: 现在，研究人员通过对 200 多头驴的基因组进行分析，追溯到它们的驯化起源于约 7000 年前东非的一次单一事件——这比人类驯服马的时间早了约 3000 年。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

researcher.sentenceEn: In the study, the researchers compared the historical fire cadence with the wildfires recorded over the past few decades, and uncovered a striking shortfall.
researcher.translationZh: 研究人员在研究中将历史火灾频率与过去几十年记录的野火进行了对比，发现两者之间存在显著差距。
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

researcher.sentenceEn: "Through their DNA, the animals are telling their history themselves," co-author Samantha Brooks, an equine researcher at the University of Florida, says in a statement.
researcher.translationZh: 佛罗里达大学马类研究员、论文共同作者萨曼莎·布鲁克斯在一份声明中表示：‘这些动物正通过它们的 DNA 亲自讲述着自己的历史。’
researcher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

researcher.sentenceEn: Accessing databases is essential to researchers .
researcher.translationZh: 访问数据库对研究人员来说至关重要。

reduce.sentenceEn: They rid the forest of dead and sick trees, reducing competition and curbing the spread of disease.
reduce.translationZh: 它们清除了森林中的枯树和病树，减少了竞争并遏制了疾病的传播。
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

reduce.sentenceEn: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias, and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands.
reduce.translationZh: 研究还发现，阅读能让我们更乐于助人，减少偏见，甚至延长寿命——如果我们手里有一本好书，我们将更加享受这份长寿带来的乐趣。

reduce.sentenceEn: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
reduce.translationZh: 我们正在通过取消一个舞台、减少表演嘉宾人数以及采取其他削减措施来降低成本。与此同时，我们仍将竭尽全力，确保音乐节一如既往地充满活力，继续支持当地艺术家和商家，并坚守参与者们所期待的柳条公园（Wicker Park）那独特的精神与名声。
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

reduce.sentenceEn: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe and 80% are in decline, mostly because intensive chemical farming has reduced many species to tiny fragments of habitat and small nature reserves.
reduce.translationZh: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶物种相对较少，其中80%的物种数量正在下降，这主要是因为集约化的化学农业将许多物种的栖息地缩减为零星的小块区域和小型自然保护区。

reduce.sentenceEn: " Reducing deaths in an emergency is a good target to have, but it's the lowest target," says climate researcher Chandni Singh.
reduce.translationZh: 气候研究员钱德妮·辛格表示：“将紧急情况下的死亡人数降至最低是一个合理目标，但这只是最基本的目标。”
reduce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

rate.sentenceEn: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates , we are lagging behind many of our peers.
rate.translationZh: 从预期寿命到癌症及婴儿死亡率，我们都落后于许多同类国家。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

rate.sentenceEn: While the FTC is doing what it can to ensure apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of their sensitive health information, the rate at which these health apps are hitting the market demonstrates just how immense of a challenge this is.
rate.translationZh: 尽管联邦贸易委员会正尽其所能确保应用程序履行对消费者在敏感健康信息处理方面的承诺，但这些健康应用程序涌入市场的速度表明，这是一项多么艰巨的挑战。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

rate.sentenceEn: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
rate.translationZh: 在新罕布什尔州，租金空置率已降至1%以下，住房权益倡导者担心，不受监管的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

rate.sentenceEn: Oman rated Scovell's significance highly, but at the same time, the general nature of his History meant that he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself.
rate.translationZh: 奥曼高度评价斯科维尔的重要性，但同时，由于其《半岛战争史》的通史性质，他无法详细分析这位名不见经传的军官对那场国家间的伟大斗争可能做出了哪些贡献，也无法确切地告诉我们关于斯科维尔本人的更多信息。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

rate.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates , blood donation and returning library books.
rate.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔曾预测这种干预不会产生任何效果；他此前发现，伦理学教授在一系列行为上与其他教授并无不同，包括投票率、献血行为和归还图书馆书籍的情况。
rate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

rate.sentenceEn: Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.
rate.translationZh: 其出租空置率正在缓慢上升。

risk.sentenceEn: There is a risk of deepening societal beauty pressures and perpetuating unattainable beauty standards.
risk.translationZh: 这存在加深社会审美压力并使不可及的审美标准持续存在的风险。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

risk.sentenceEn: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
risk.translationZh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

risk.sentenceEn: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk .
risk.translationZh: 她表示，各城市尤其应当绘制一份脆弱群体分布图，以便将应对措施重点放在风险最高的人群上。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

risk.sentenceEn: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
risk.translationZh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

risk.sentenceEn: But in other places, nighttime temperatures or humidity might be as important a gauge of risk as daytime highs.
risk.translationZh: 但在其他地区，夜间温度或湿度可能与日间高温一样，是衡量风险的重要指标。
risk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

risk.sentenceEn: Before, they might not insure the ones who felt like a high risk or charge them too much, or they would charge them too little and then it would cost the company money.
risk.translationZh: 以前，保险公司可能不会为那些看似高风险的客户提供保险，或者对他们收取过高费用，又或者收费过低，最终导致公司蒙受损失。

reading.sentenceEn: Forget self-help books; reading is self-help in action.
reading.translationZh: 忘掉那些励志书吧；阅读本身就是一种自我救赎。

reading.sentenceEn: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias, and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands.
reading.translationZh: 研究还发现，阅读能让我们更乐于助人，减少偏见，甚至延长寿命——如果我们手里有一本好书，我们将更加享受这份长寿带来的乐趣。

reading.sentenceEn: Some will say the audiobook boom revives it, though I suppose you can then worry about the decline of reading .
reading.translationZh: 有人会说有声书的兴起让它得以复兴，不过我想接下来你可能又要担心阅读能力的下降了。
reading.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reading.sentenceEn: Reading will keep you better informed about the world but it can also improve our tech-shattered ability to concentrate.
reading.translationZh: 阅读不仅能让你更全面地了解世界，还能修复因科技干扰而受损的专注力。

reading.sentenceEn: Reading is cheap, easy and, most important, it's fun.
reading.translationZh: 阅读既省钱又方便，而且最重要的是，它充满乐趣。

reading.sentenceEn: expanding vocabulary helps develop reading fluency
reading.translationZh: 扩大词汇量有助于提高阅读流畅度

reader.sentenceEn: We are living through a golden age of science writing, so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery.
reader.translationZh: 我们正生活在科普写作的黄金时代，这些作品清晰易懂，即便是外行读者也能领略科学发现中那不可预知的魅力。

reader.sentenceEn: Its energy and rhythm can capture a reader , transport them to another world and make them see things differently.
reader.translationZh: 诗歌的活力与韵律能够抓住读者的心，将他们带入另一个世界，让他们以全新的视角看待事物。
reader.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reader.sentenceEn: These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers.
reader.translationZh: 这些是《自然》杂志读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究人员合作的文章中，用来描述他们参与艺术与科学合作体验的部分词汇。
reader.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reader.sentenceEn: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.
reader.translationZh: 面对向读者免费提供其产品的要求，出版商的应对之策是向作者收取费用，以覆盖文章的编辑处理成本。
reader.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reader.sentenceEn: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is " reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
reader.translationZh: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人认为虚假新闻现象的首要原因是“读者错误”，这一因素超过了虚构故事或报道中的事实错误。
reader.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

reader.translationZh: 获取读者对它们的看法。

recently.sentenceEn: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
recently.translationZh: 最近得知一些科学家为了减少碳排放而打算缩减研究规模，我感到十分震惊。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

recently.sentenceEn: Elephants are very choosy eaters, but until recently little was known about how they selected their food.
recently.translationZh: 大象在饮食方面非常挑剔，但直到最近，人们对它们如何选择食物仍知之甚少。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

recently.sentenceEn: Virginia, Colorado and Utah have also recently passed state consumer data privacy legislation.
recently.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚州、科罗拉多州和犹他州最近也通过了本州的消费者数据隐私法规。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

recently.sentenceEn: Recently , another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.
recently.translationZh: 最近，这种掠夺性行为又出现了新的表现形式：所谓的支持服务咨询公司，它们为作者个人和期刊提供语言及其他编辑支持，有时会建议投稿人在其文章中添加大量引文。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

recently.sentenceEn: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
recently.translationZh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

recently.sentenceEn: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level.
recently.translationZh: 立法者和监管机构正逐步开始着手解决暗模式相关的模糊地带问题，最近的行动主要在州一级展开。
recently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

reform.sentenceEn: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms , we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
reform.translationZh: 然而，尽管二十年来我们制定了各种策略并实施了多项重大医疗改革，但在实现这些目标方面我们并未取得实质性进展。
reform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reform.sentenceEn: That is why the Reform think tank is launching a new programme of work entitled "Reimagining health", supported by ten former health ministers.
reform.translationZh: 正因如此，改革智库在十位前卫生部长的支持下，启动了一项名为“重塑健康”的新工作方案。
reform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reform.sentenceEn: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
reform.translationZh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
reform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reform.sentenceEn: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
reform.translationZh: 法国拟议的这项税收是一个明确的警告：除非各国能就国际税收体系改革达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会纷纷效仿，而美国企业将面临数十个国家征收的一系列不同税收，这将被证明是既繁重又代价高昂的。
reform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reform.sentenceEn: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
reform.translationZh: 这就是近年来多次改革立法尝试均以失败告终的原因，使得邮政总局除了推迟至关重要的现代化进程外，几乎无力支付账单。
reform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reform.sentenceEn: It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries.
reform.translationZh: 这引发了商业渔业的根本性改革。

response.sentenceEn: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses , researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
response.translationZh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
response.translationZh: 她表示，各城市尤其应当绘制一份脆弱群体分布图，以便将应对措施重点放在风险最高的人群上。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

response.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
response.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass".
response.translationZh: 去年有一份呼吁禁止人造草坪的请愿书征集到了3万个签名，对此政府回应称其“暂无计划禁止人造草坪的使用”。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

response.sentenceEn: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
response.translationZh: 研究人员此前曾报告称，尽管植物没有大脑，但其茎和叶中电信号的传递仍会引发暗示意识存在的反应。
response.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

response.sentenceEn: You make further inferences, for instance, about how the text may be significant to you, or about its validity – inferences that form the basis of a personal response for which the author will inevitably be far less responsible.
response.translationZh: 你会进一步进行推断，例如，推断文本对你可能具有何种意义，或推断其有效性——这些推断构成了个人回应的基础，而作者对此个人回应的责任无疑要小得多。

reveal.sentenceEn: Not only does understanding the equines' genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might improve their management in the future, as climate change alters the planet's environment, write the authors.
reveal.translationZh: 作者写道，了解马科动物的基因构成不仅有助于揭示它们对人类历史的贡献，而且随着气候变化改变地球环境，这还可能改善未来对它们的管理。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reveal.sentenceEn: Excavations revealed a large number of Minoan-style loom weights, suggesting Pavlopetri was a thriving trade center with a robust textile industry.
reveal.translationZh: 考古发掘发现了大量米诺斯风格的织布机砝码，表明帕夫洛佩特里曾是一个繁荣的贸易中心，拥有发达的纺织业。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

reveal.sentenceEn: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
reveal.translationZh: 在城市中规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，那些被称为'欲望小径'的非官方路径如同社区留下的隐形足迹，它们揭示了人们未曾言说的偏好、共同使用的捷径以及群体的集体选择。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

reveal.sentenceEn: For example, AI can be used to analyse what type of advertising content or copy would be appropriate to "speak" to a specific target customer group by revealing information about trends and preferences through the analysis of big data.
reveal.translationZh: 例如，人工智能可以通过大数据分析揭示有关趋势和偏好的信息，从而分析出何种类型的广告内容或文案适合与特定目标客户群体进行“沟通”。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reveal.sentenceEn: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.
reveal.translationZh: 该附录列出了许多从西班牙法军手中缴获的加密文件，而这些文件的秘密正是由英国总部的一名军官——乔治·斯科维尔的工作所揭开的。
reveal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

respond.sentenceEn: "We know enough to know that this is a concern, but we don't know enough about how to respond to it yet. That's a great area to be doing research."
respond.translationZh: 我们已经了解到这确实是个问题，但对于如何应对，目前掌握的信息还不够充分。这正是开展研究的绝佳领域。
respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

respond.sentenceEn: The main disadvantage of using AI to respond to customers is that there are concerns about trusting personal interactions to machines, which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.
respond.translationZh: 使用人工智能回应客户的主要缺点在于，人们对于将人际互动交由机器处理存在顾虑，这不仅可能导致后续人际连接的丧失，还可能造成营销人员的减少。
respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

respond.sentenceEn: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has "no plans to ban the use of artificial grass".
respond.translationZh: 去年有一份呼吁禁止人造草坪的请愿书征集到了3万个签名，对此政府回应称其“暂无计划禁止人造草坪的使用”。
respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

respond.sentenceEn: Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future.
respond.translationZh: 在随文附带的调查中，约350名受访者中近40%表示曾与艺术家合作过；几乎所有人都表示未来会考虑这样做。

respond.sentenceEn: Fewer artists than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements.

respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

respond.sentenceEn: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.

respond.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

responsibility.sentenceEn: But by building a culture of digital responsibility within our businesses, we can create a future where AI can help us without spilling the beans.

responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

responsibility.sentenceEn: Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation, and access to information.
responsibility.translationZh: 图书馆和档案馆历来肩负着信息的组织、保存与获取的责任。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

responsibility.sentenceEn: "For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall."
responsibility.translationZh: 几十年来，我们一直未能承担起投资国内木材供应的责任，这使我们面临价格波动的风险，并且随着全球需求上升而我们自身供应下降，我们还将为未来的木材供应而竞争。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

responsibility.sentenceEn: The responsibility for the latest wave of strikes rests on the unions.
responsibility.translationZh: 最近一波罢工的责任在于工会。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

responsibility.sentenceEn: It was the purpose and responsibility of great minds to go forth and seek out the truth, which they believed to be founded in knowledge.
responsibility.translationZh: 探索并追求真理是伟人们的使命与责任，他们坚信真理植根于知识之中。
responsibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

responsibility.sentenceEn: Don't fear responsibility for your life
responsibility.translationZh: 不要害怕为自己的人生负责

range.sentenceEn: AI can be a collaborative tool in a wide range of creative endeavors.

range.translationZh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。

range.sentenceEn: The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
range.translationZh: 英国当前局面的成因复杂多样，既包括对生产性林业的过时认知，也涉及灰松鼠对树木的大规模破坏。
range.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

range.sentenceEn: Despite these challenges, Jackson captured dozens of striking photos, ranging from majestic images like his now-famous snapshot of Old Faithful, to casual portraits of expedition members at the camp.

range.sentenceEn: The researchers studied "prosocial" and rebellious traits in more than 200 children and young adults, ranging from 11 to 28 years old.
range.translationZh: 研究人员对200多名11至28岁的儿童和年轻人的“亲社会”特质与叛逆特质进行了研究。
range.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

reality.sentenceEn: In his Oxford lectures, Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality , a "glimpsed alternative" that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large.
reality.translationZh: 西amus·希尼在牛津大学的讲座中指出，诗歌描绘了一种现实图景，即一种“瞥见的替代性可能”。这种可能从细微到宏大等各个层面，都与你当下的现实构成了矛盾。

reality.sentenceEn: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
reality.translationZh: 现实情况却截然不同。正如我受文化部门委托对英国公共图书馆进行的独立审查报告所显示的，该报告已于昨日发布。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

reality.sentenceEn: Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.

reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

reality.sentenceEn: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
reality.translationZh: 但事实是，你的老板可能对你的评价非常高。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

reality.sentenceEn: The reality is that water, and the pollutants that so often come with it, don't respect state boundaries.
reality.translationZh: 现实情况是，水以及常随水而来的污染物不会受州界的限制。
reality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

reality.sentenceEn: Its continuous supply is becoming a reality .
reality.translationZh: 其持续供应正成为现实。

revenue.sentenceEn: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue .

revenue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

revenue.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.

revenue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

revenue.sentenceEn: Campgrounds are a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog, and businesses in the parks hand over, on average, only about 5% of their revenues to the National Park Service.
revenue.translationZh: 营地只是整体基础设施维修积压项目中的一小部分，而园区内企业平均仅将约5%的收入上缴国家公园管理局。
revenue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

revenue.sentenceEn: As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.
revenue.translationZh: 结果，升级量激增，收入增长了92%。
revenue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

revenue.sentenceEn: This can mean millions more in revenue .
revenue.translationZh: 这可能意味着数百万美元的额外收入。

rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

rely.sentenceEn: The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.
rely.translationZh: 事实上，与那些由城市主办的大型音乐节不同，你家门口的社区街道节庆活动得不到任何城市拨款，只能依靠赞助、摊位费和入场捐款来维持运营。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

rely.sentenceEn: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
rely.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

rely.sentenceEn: Innovation and research have relied on public participation in science for centuries.
rely.translationZh: 几个世纪以来，创新与研究一直依赖公众对科学的参与。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rely.sentenceEn: The Time to Act study also found that while control pupils relied on "desert island clichés" such as palm trees, target pupils were "more expansive [giving] a broader picture of the sky, the sea and the atmospheric conditions".
rely.translationZh: 《及时行动》研究还发现，对照组学生依赖诸如“棕榈树”之类的“荒岛陈词滥调”，而目标组学生则“表达更为丰富，展现出天空、海洋和大气状况的更广阔图景”。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

rely.translationZh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
rely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

replace.sentenceEn: It's important to note that while AI can enhance our appreciation of beauty, it should not replace the genuine human experience and the emotional connections we derive from seeing the beauty in each other.
replace.translationZh: 需要注意的是，虽然人工智能可以提升我们对美的欣赏，但它不应取代真实的人类体验，以及我们在彼此身上发现美时所产生的这种情感纽带。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

replace.sentenceEn: Without constant migration of digital assets, a nightmare about the foreseeable future is what keeps historians up at night: a historical record that abruptly stops when digital replaces analog.
replace.translationZh: 如果数字资产无法持续迁移，历史学家们将对可预见的未来感到忧心忡忡：当数字取代模拟技术时，历史记录可能会突然中断。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

replace.sentenceEn: Replacing swing doors, these allow smaller buildings to maximise the usable space inside without having to clear the way for a large, sticking-out door.

replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

replace.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
replace.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
replace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

replace.sentenceEn: Although good TV shows can help stir children's interest in conservation, they cannot replace the excitement of a zoo visit as an intense, immersive and interactive experience.
replace.translationZh: 尽管优秀的电视节目有助于激发孩子们对动物保护的兴趣，但它们无法取代动物园参观所带来的那种强烈、沉浸式且互动性强的体验所带来的兴奋感。

replace.translationZh: 转而选择可持续的替代方案

regulation.sentenceEn: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations .
regulation.translationZh: 高空平台系统还可以指导住宅翻新工作或修改建筑法规。

regulation.translationZh: 该团体正处于动员初期，未来可能会推动新政策或法规的制定。

regulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

regulation.sentenceEn: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations .

regulation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

regulation.sentenceEn: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation , particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.

relationship.sentenceEn: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species.
relationship.translationZh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。

relationship.translationZh: 你可能会把这种拒绝视为暗示你与他们的关系状况存在某种负面问题。

relationship.sentenceEn: And if the postgraduate student population also grows rapidly and there is loss of a close apprenticeship relationship between faculty members and students, the student culture becomes the chief socializing force for new postgraduate students, with consequences for the intellectual and academic life of the institution-this was seen in America as well as in France, Italy, West Germany, and Japan.

relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

relationship.sentenceEn: This may not only do damage to your relationship with your child but also affect your child's self-esteem.
relationship.translationZh: 这不仅可能损害你与孩子的关系，还可能影响孩子的自尊心。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

relationship.sentenceEn: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships .
relationship.translationZh: 而内疚感通过促使我们更深刻地反思自己的道德品质，可以鼓励人们弥补过失并修复关系。
relationship.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

requirement.sentenceEn: Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.

requirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

requirement.sentenceEn: Hom said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but "if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more."

requirement.translationZh: 许多雇主也逐渐意识到，某些岗位无需将学历作为硬性要求，这样做自有其优势。

requirement.sentenceEn: Fewer artists than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements .
requirement.translationZh: 在《自然》杂志的这项调查中，艺术家的回应人数少于科学家；然而，一些受访者指出，艺术家并非仅仅是帮助科学家满足其传播需求。

requirement.sentenceEn: They tend to fall short of official requirements .

reward.sentenceEn: That timing could reward high-quality service and give workers an incentive to provide it.
reward.translationZh: 这种时间安排能够奖励高质量服务，并激励员工提供优质服务。

reward.sentenceEn: " Reward sensitivity" measures how much reward it takes to outweigh risk.
reward.translationZh: "奖励敏感性"衡量的是需要多少奖励才能抵消风险。

reward.sentenceEn: Teenagers are particularly sensitive to social rewards —winning the game, impressing a new friend, getting that boy to notice you.

reflect.sentenceEn: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood, and identity.
