reflect.sentenceEn: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
reflect.translationZh: 此类争论反映了全美范围内的激烈讨论，研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生都在不断呼吁，要求学校更加重视气候变化事实的教学。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reflect.sentenceEn: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
reflect.translationZh: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量，包括期刊的公认质量（体现在该刊的影响因子上）以及特定论文积累的引用次数。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

reflect.sentenceEn: And third, growth was reflected in changes in the proportion of the relevant age group enrolled in institutions of higher education.
reflect.translationZh: 第三，高等教育的发展体现在相关年龄段人群中高等教育机构入学比例的变化上。
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

reflect.sentenceEn: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
reflect.translationZh: 换而言之：我们如何确保智能机器的思维能够反映人类的最高价值观？
reflect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

remove.sentenceEn: It swiftly became an obsession as he recovered from a successful operation to remove the cancer.
remove.translationZh: 在他成功接受癌症切除手术后康复期间，这件事迅速成为了他的执念。

remove.sentenceEn: To those of you in the comments section who are having strong feelings about artifacts being removed from cities in the U.S. and Britain and returned to their countries of origin, I would ask you to consider why do you think Americans have more of a right to easily access the Benin Bronzes than the people of Nigeria?
remove.translationZh: 对于评论区中那些对从美国和英国城市移走文物并将其归还给原籍国一事怀有强烈情绪的人，我想请你们思考：为什么你们认为美国人比尼日利亚人更有权利轻松接触到贝宁青铜器？
remove.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

remove.sentenceEn: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections".
remove.translationZh: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，水石书店各分店经理接到指示，要求将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍从展台、陈列区和橱窗等显眼位置移走，并将其“悄然归位到相应的分类区域”。
remove.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

remove.sentenceEn: Some believe that AI is negatively impacting on the marketer's role by reducing creativity and removing jobs, but they are aware that it is a way of reducing costs and creating new information.
remove.translationZh: 一些人认为，人工智能通过降低创造力和减少就业机会，对营销人员的角色产生了负面影响，但他们也意识到，人工智能是一种降低成本和创造新信息的方式。
remove.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

remove.sentenceEn: Companies are using artificial intelligence to remove some of the unconscious bias from hiring decisions.
remove.translationZh: 企业正利用人工智能来消除招聘决策中的一些无意识偏见。
remove.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

remove.sentenceEn: The credit limit will be removed .
remove.translationZh: 信用额度限制将会被取消。

represent.sentenceEn: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession."
represent.translationZh: 如果这听起来有些夸大其词，请考虑这样一个事实：代表约 3000 名电影从业者的工会——美国艺术指导工会，已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发布声明称：“凭良心讲，我们无法鼓励你们从事这一职业。”
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

represent.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
represent.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

represent.sentenceEn: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
represent.translationZh: 这些由集体“违规”踏出的路径，常常在整齐的绿地中形成一条条被踩出的泥土小径，它们抄近道、横穿草坪、翻越山丘，展现了人类（和动物）以最有效方式从A点到达B点的本能倾向。
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

represent.sentenceEn: It inspired me to learn more about the culture that it represented .
represent.translationZh: 它激发了我去更多地了解这件雕塑所代表的文化。
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

represent.sentenceEn: Simply, there are people in Nigeria who cannot travel to the Smithsonian Institution to see that part of their history and culture represented by the Benin Bronzes.
represent.translationZh: 简而言之，尼日利亚有些人无法前往史密森学会，去亲眼目睹贝宁青铜器所代表的那部分本国历史与文化。
represent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

represent.sentenceEn: Which of the following statements best represents Lownie's view?
represent.translationZh: 以下哪种说法最能代表劳尼的观点？

recognize.sentenceEn: One of the turning points in public support for land conservation efforts—and recognizing the magnificence of the Yellowstone region in particular—came in the form of vivid photographs.
recognize.translationZh: 公众对土地保护工作的支持，尤其是对黄石地区壮丽景色的认识，其转折点之一便是这些生动的照片。

recognize.sentenceEn: Though Native Americans (and later miners and fur trappers) had long recognized the area's riches, most Americans did not.
recognize.translationZh: 尽管美洲原住民（以及后来的矿工和毛皮猎人）早已认识到这片土地的富饶，但大多数美国人却并不了解。

recognize.sentenceEn: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.
recognize.translationZh: 2016年，研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式，包括作者群体间不成比例地相互引用，以及期刊群体间频繁相互引用以提高其出版物影响因子的行为。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

recognize.sentenceEn: While attractive, new ideas can be distracting; the team leader must recognize when these ideas don't serve the current goal and need to be put on the back burner.
recognize.translationZh: 新想法虽然诱人，但可能会分散注意力；团队领导者必须识别出哪些想法无助于当前目标实现，需要暂时搁置。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

recognize.sentenceEn: Plants can't run away from danger, so investing energy in a body system which recognizes a threat and can feel pain would be a very poor evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
recognize.translationZh: 文章指出，植物无法逃离危险，因此将能量投入到一个能够识别威胁并感知疼痛的身体系统中，将是一种非常糟糕的进化策略。
recognize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

recognize.sentenceEn: Contributions of librarians should be recognized .
recognize.translationZh: 图书馆员的贡献应当得到认可。

resource.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species, which don't produce seeds every year.
resource.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

resource.sentenceEn: They pool resources , collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science for the sake of science without the traditional boundaries of working inside a formal setting.
resource.translationZh: 他们汇聚资源、通力协作、跳出思维定式，在不受正式工作环境传统界限束缚的情况下，为了科学而探索科学，寻找解决问题的方法并克服各种障碍。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

resource.sentenceEn: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
resource.translationZh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

resource.sentenceEn: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes.
resource.translationZh: 研究人员确信，大象总能精确地知道自己相对于所需资源的位置，因此它们既能走熟悉的路线，也能抄近路。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

resource.sentenceEn: New research suggests that smell is a crucial factor in guiding elephants—and probably other herbivores—to the best food resources .
resource.translationZh: 新研究表明，嗅觉是引导大象——很可能还有其他食草动物——找到最佳食物资源的关键因素。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

resource.sentenceEn: Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors.
resource.translationZh: 诚然，英国的城镇并非没有资格申请，但它们普遍缺乏资源来准备一份能够击败更强大竞争对手的申办方案。
resource.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

related.sentenceEn: You can then find groups and activities related to those where you will be able to meet like-minded people.
related.translationZh: 然后，你可以找到与这些爱好相关的团体和活动，在那里你能遇到志同道合的人。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

related.sentenceEn: If you look at the apps on your phone, chances are you have at least one related to your health—and probably several.
related.translationZh: 看看你手机上的应用程序，很可能至少有一款与健康相关——或许还有好几款。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

related.sentenceEn: It is closely related to song and even when written it is usually created to be performed out loud.
related.translationZh: 诗歌与歌曲渊源深厚，即便被书写成文，也通常是为了能够被大声吟诵而创作的。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

related.sentenceEn: Karen R. Sime: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
related.translationZh: 卡伦·R·赛姆：虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人踏上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

related.sentenceEn: But another, related force – a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called "grade forgiveness" – is helping raise GPAs.
related.translationZh: 但另一个相关因素——一项常被深藏在课程目录中的政策，称为“成绩宽恕”——正在助长平均绩点的上升。
related.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

related.sentenceEn: It is advisable for students to choose an extracurricular activity that is related to their future study at college.
related.translationZh: 学生最好选择与他们未来大学学习相关的课外活动。

ruling.sentenceEn: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
ruling.translationZh: 然而，所有这一切在上个月末陷入了巨大的危机——美国最高法院就爱达荷州的一起案件作出裁决，大幅削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)对湿地和水道的监管权。
ruling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ruling.sentenceEn: It is too easy, and misleading, to see such court rulings as merely standing up for the rights of land owners when the consequences can be so dire for their neighbors.
ruling.translationZh: 如果只将此类法院裁决视为维护土地所有者的权利，而忽视其可能给周边社区带来的严重后果，这种看法不仅过于简单，而且具有误导性。
ruling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ruling.sentenceEn: On Tuesday, the appeals court unanimously upheld the 2017 order deregulating broadband providers, citing a Supreme Court ruling from 2005 that upheld a similarly deregulatory move.
ruling.translationZh: 周二，上诉法院一致维持了2017年那份放松宽带提供商监管的命令，并援引了最高法院2005年的一项裁决，该裁决同样支持了放松监管的举措。
ruling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ruling.sentenceEn: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
ruling.translationZh: 这项裁决对在多州设有实体门店的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常已经对在线购物征收销售税。
ruling.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

ruling.sentenceEn: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling ?
ruling.translationZh: 谁最有可能欢迎最高法院的这项裁决？

ruling.sentenceEn: Its ruling complies with the court decisions.
ruling.translationZh: 其裁决与法院判决一致。

regular.sentenceEn: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
regular.translationZh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

regular.sentenceEn: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
regular.translationZh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

regular.sentenceEn: Yes, more investment is needed, but passengers will not be willing to pay more indefinitely if they must also endure cramped, unreliable services, punctuated by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently.
regular.translationZh: 诚然，铁路系统需要更多投资，但如果乘客还得忍受拥挤不堪、班次不准的服务，加上时刻表变动或计划性维护管理不当引发的频繁混乱，他们是不会心甘情愿无限期地支付更高票价的。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

regular.sentenceEn: In 2007, Indonesia started phasing in a program that gives money to its poorest residents under certain conditions, such as requiring people to keep kids in school or get regular medical care.
regular.translationZh: 2007年，印度尼西亚开始逐步实施一项计划，在特定条件下向最贫困的居民提供资金，例如要求人们让孩子上学或接受定期医疗保健。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

regular.sentenceEn: A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular 'pearly whites' was a rare sight in Victorian society, the preserve of the super-rich (and even then, dental hygiene was not guaranteed).
regular.translationZh: 在维多利亚时代的社会中，拥有一口健康洁净、整齐洁白的“珍珠皓齿”实属罕见，这是超级富豪的专属（即便如此，牙齿卫生也无法保证）。
regular.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

regular.sentenceEn: Regular people mock it but accept it.
regular.translationZh: 普通人一边调侃它，一边又心甘情愿地接受它。

recession.sentenceEn: Millennials "remember their father and mother both were laid off. They blame it on the manufacturing recession ," says Birgit Klohs, chief executive of The Right Place, a business development agency for western Michigan.
recession.translationZh: 密歇根州西部商业发展机构“The Right Place”的首席执行官比尔吉特·克洛斯表示，千禧一代“记得他们的父母都曾失业。他们将此归咎于制造业衰退。”
recession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

recession.sentenceEn: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession , those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
recession.translationZh: 从职业发展到社区生活再到家庭观念，这些差异表明，在灼痛人心的"大衰退"之后，那些刚刚踏入社会的年轻人正在确立自己的优先事项和期望，而这些观念将逐渐渗透到美国生活的方方面面，从消费偏好到住房模式，再到政治取向。
recession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

recession.sentenceEn: Involuntary part-time employment is still far higher than before the recession , but it is down by 640,000 (7.9 percent) from its year ago level.
recession.translationZh: 非自愿兼职就业人数虽仍远高于经济衰退前水平，但较去年同期已减少64万人（下降7.9%）。
recession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

recession.sentenceEn: Davidson's article is one of a number of pieces that have recently appeared making the point that the reason we have such stubbornly high unemployment and declining middle-class incomes today is largely because of the big drop in demand because of the Great Recession , but it is also because of the advances in both globalization and the information technology revolution, which are more rapidly than ever replacing labor with machines or foreign workers.
recession.translationZh: 戴维森的文章是近期发表的一系列文章之一，这些文章都阐明了一个观点：如今失业率居高不下、中产阶级收入不断下降，在很大程度上是由于大衰退导致的需求大幅下降，但同时也因为全球化的推进和信息技术革命的发展，这些因素正以前所未有的速度用机器或外国劳动力取代本土劳动力。
recession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

recession.sentenceEn: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning.
recession.translationZh: 大衰退或许已经结束，但这个高失业率时代很可能才刚刚开始。
recession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

recession.sentenceEn: The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
recession.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特的研究表明，并非所有在经济衰退期毕业的人都会发现自己的人生机遇变得黯淡：那些拥有精英大学学位的毕业生能相当迅速地追赶上如果他们在经济状况较好时期毕业本该拥有的地位；而被甩在后面的是那些学历不如他们的普通大众。
recession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

responsible.sentenceEn: What health functions should remain at the centre, and what should be given to local leaders, often responsible for services that create health, and with a much better understanding of the needs of their populations?
responsible.translationZh: 哪些卫生职能应保留在中央层面，哪些应下放给地方领导人？地方领导人通常负责提供创造健康条件的服务，并且对当地居民的需求有更深入的了解。
responsible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

responsible.sentenceEn: They also provide an opportunity to talk to the people responsible for growing or raising your food, support your local economy and pick up fresh seasonal produce—all at the same time.
responsible.translationZh: 它们还让你有机会与负责种植或养殖你食物的人交谈，支持当地经济，同时选购新鲜的时令农产品——这一切都可以同时实现。
responsible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

responsible.sentenceEn: The growth leader is also responsible for keeping the team focused on moving forward and steering them clear of distractions.
responsible.translationZh: 增长团队领导者还负责保持团队专注于前进方向，并引导他们避开干扰。
responsible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

responsible.sentenceEn: Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions.
responsible.translationZh: 企业应当与IT、合规、风险和法律团队共同商议，审查其隐私政策，并将负责公司用户界面的客户/用户体验设计师和编码人员，以及负责注册、结账购物车、定价和促销的营销人员与广告人员纳入讨论范围。
responsible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

responsible.sentenceEn: According to the author, what may chiefly be responsible for the moral decline of Japanese society?
responsible.translationZh: 根据作者的观点，日本社会道德滑坡的主要原因可能是什么？
responsible.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

responsible.sentenceEn: You make further inferences, for instance, about how the text may be significant to you, or about its validity – inferences that form the basis of a personal response for which the author will inevitably be far less responsible .
responsible.translationZh: 你会进一步进行推断，例如，推断文本对你可能具有何种意义，或推断其有效性——这些推断构成了个人回应的基础，而作者对此个人回应的责任无疑要小得多。

retirement.sentenceEn: Other life changes can trigger periods of loneliness too, such as retirement , changing jobs or becoming a parent.
retirement.translationZh: 其他生活变化也可能引发孤独期，例如退休、换工作或成为父母。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

retirement.sentenceEn: "The concept of retirement is evolving," said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade.
retirement.translationZh: “退休的概念正在演变，”德美利证券退休业务高级经理克里斯汀·拉塞尔表示。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

retirement.sentenceEn: One reason for the change in retirement patterns: Americans are living longer.
retirement.translationZh: 退休模式发生变化的一个原因是：美国人的寿命越来越长。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

retirement.sentenceEn: "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement ."
retirement.translationZh: 这不仅仅与经济因素有关。工作的价值也促使人们在退休后继续工作。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

retirement.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, many people who are opting to work in retirement are preparing to do so because they are worried about making ends meet in their later years, said Brent Weiss, a co-founder at Baltimore-based financial-planning firm Facet Wealth.
retirement.translationZh: 巴尔的摩金融规划公司Facet Wealth的联合创始人布伦特·韦斯表示，遗憾的是，许多选择退休后继续工作的人是因为担心晚年无法维持生计才这样做的。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

retirement.sentenceEn: Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
retirement.translationZh: 更令人惊讶的是，超过一半的“未退休者”——那些计划退休后继续工作或退休后重返职场的人——表示，即使他们有足够的钱安享晚年，也仍会在晚年继续工作。
retirement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reaction.sentenceEn: This is a reaction to Hollywood's decline, which is reaching a critical point for the industry and Southern California.
reaction.translationZh: 这是对好莱坞衰落的一种回应，而这种衰落正使该产业以及南加州地区陷入危急关头。
reaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reaction.sentenceEn: "Our findings indicate that people do not only feel different when they are the centre of attention but that their brain reactions also differ."
reaction.translationZh: 我们的研究结果表明，当人们成为关注的焦点时，他们不仅会有不同的感受，其大脑反应也会有所不同。
reaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

reaction.sentenceEn: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
reaction.translationZh: 最为极端且完全非法的回应是Sci-Hub的出现——这是一个2012年创建的全球性科学论文“复印机”，目前宣称能够提供2015年以来发表的每一篇付费墙内文章的访问权限。
reaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reaction.sentenceEn: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
reaction.translationZh: 他们的反应可能是瞬时 reflexes、过往驾驶经验的积累以及当时视听信息的复杂综合。
reaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

reaction.sentenceEn: This normal human reaction is used to protect us by signaling danger and preparing us to deal with it.
reaction.translationZh: 这种正常的人类反应通过发出危险信号并让我们做好应对准备来保护我们。
reaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reaction.sentenceEn: It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself.
reaction.translationZh: 这也是为什么当我们试图用语言描述音乐时，我们所能做的只是表达自己对音乐的感受，而无法真正领会音乐本身。
reaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

recommend.sentenceEn: And that's a shame, because there is much to recommend in the idea of scientific literacy as it was originally articulated in 1945, a time when science appeared to be the key to progress and scientists seemingly held the fate of the world in their hands.
recommend.translationZh: 这实在令人遗憾，因为“科学素养”这一概念在 1945 年最初提出时，有很多值得推崇之处。在那个时代，科学似乎是进步的关键，而科学家们也仿佛掌握着世界的命运。
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

recommend.sentenceEn: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
recommend.translationZh: 该审查报告建议发起一项全国性的品牌宣传活动，以增强图书馆的实体感；重新推行一项让会员持卡即可使用全国任一图书馆的计划；以及为儿童自动办理入会手续。
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

recommend.sentenceEn: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
recommend.translationZh: 研究人员表示，高温行动计划不应只包含短期应急响应，还应推荐能够让社区更凉爽的中长期措施。
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

recommend.sentenceEn: Ed Home, of the RHS, said: "We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment."
recommend.translationZh: 英国皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍姆表示：“我们去年启动了可持续发展战略，而人造草坪不符合我们的理念以及对塑料的立场。我们建议使用天然草坪，因为它具有诸多环境益处，包括支持野生动物生存、缓解洪涝灾害以及降低环境温度。”
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

recommend.sentenceEn: All the experts we spoke with highly recommend walking because it's the easiest, most accessible form of exercise.
recommend.translationZh: 我们采访的所有专家都极力推荐步行，因为它是最简单、最容易开展的运动形式。
recommend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

recommend.sentenceEn: What does "national" mean? Roy Romanow and Senator Michael Kirby recommended a federal-provincial body much like the recently created National Health Council.
recommend.translationZh: 那么，“全国性”究竟意味着什么？罗伊·罗曼诺和迈克尔·柯比参议员建议成立一个联邦-省际机构，与最近成立的国家卫生委员会颇为相似。
recommend.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

restoration.sentenceEn: "When you talk about conservation or restoration , the first question has to be restoration by whom, for whom?" says Daniel Janzen, a biologist at the University of Pennsylvania.
restoration.translationZh: “当你谈论保护或修复时，第一个问题必须是：由谁来修复，为了谁修复？”宾夕法尼亚大学的生物学家丹尼尔·詹森（Daniel Janzen）说道。
restoration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

restoration.sentenceEn: With so much research left to do, leaders in the field have been doing some soul-searching, and acknowledging that restoration can be motivated by — and designed to meet — different needs.
restoration.translationZh: 面对繁重的研究任务，该领域的领军人物一直在进行反思，并承认修复工作的动力和设计初衷可以源于不同的需求。
restoration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

restoration.sentenceEn: Much of the global funding for restoration is dedicated to developing it as a tool to mitigate climate change, notes restoration ecologist Pedro Brancalion.
restoration.translationZh: 修复生态学家佩德罗·布兰卡里昂指出，全球大部分用于修复工作的资金都致力于将其作为减缓气候变化的工具。
restoration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

restoration.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species, which don't produce seeds every year.
restoration.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
restoration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

restoration.sentenceEn: Their interests as stewards of the land need to be better integrated with those who have the money to support restoration .
restoration.translationZh: 他们作为土地管家的利益需要与那些拥有资金支持修复的人士的利益更好地结合起来。
restoration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

restoration.sentenceEn: Some creatures in the forest that multiply fast can become a great threat to forest restoration .
restoration.translationZh: 森林中一些繁殖迅速的生物可能会对森林恢复造成巨大威胁。

rapidly.sentenceEn: As the war unfolded, science rapidly assumed a central role.
rapidly.translationZh: 随着战争的展开，科学迅速占据了中心地位。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

rapidly.sentenceEn: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
rapidly.translationZh: 人工智能（AI）的进步正在迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rapidly.sentenceEn: These groups of people are part of a rapidly expanding biotechnological social movement of citizen scientists and professional scientists seeking to take discovery out of institutions and put it into the hands of anyone with the enthusiasm.
rapidly.translationZh: 这些人群是一个迅速发展的生物技术社会运动的组成部分，该运动由公民科学家和专业科学家共同发起，旨在将科学发现从科研机构中解放出来，交到每一个充满热情的人手中。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

rapidly.sentenceEn: And if the postgraduate student population also grows rapidly and there is loss of a close apprenticeship relationship between faculty members and students, the student culture becomes the chief socializing force for new postgraduate students, with consequences for the intellectual and academic life of the institution-this was seen in America as well as in France, Italy, West Germany, and Japan.
rapidly.translationZh: 而如果研究生人数也迅速增长，师生间紧密的师徒关系逐渐消失，那么学生文化就会成为新研究生的主要社会化力量，这将对院校的知识生活和学术生活产生影响——这种现象不仅在美国出现，在法国、意大利、西德和日本也同样存在。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

rapidly.sentenceEn: These demands resulted in a very rapid expansion of the systems of higher education, beginning in the 1960s and developing very rapidly (though unevenly) during the 1970s and 1980s.
rapidly.translationZh: 这些需求促使高等教育体系从20世纪60年代开始迅速扩张，并在70年代和80年代以极快的速度发展（尽管发展并不均衡）。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

rapidly.sentenceEn: We know we are moving into a period where the jobs in demand will change rapidly , as will the requirements of the jobs that remain.
rapidly.translationZh: 我们知道，我们正进入一个时期，市场需求的工作岗位将迅速变化，而留存岗位的要求也将随之改变。
rapidly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

royal.sentenceEn: "The research shows that the way actors work makes a big difference to the way children use language and also how they think about themselves," Jacqui O'Hanlon of the Royal Shakespeare Company (RSC), which commissioned the study, said.
royal.translationZh: 委托这项研究的英国皇家莎士比亚剧团(RSC)的杰奎·奥汉隆表示：“研究表明，演员的表演方式对儿童使用语言的方式以及他们如何看待自己有着重大影响。”
royal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

royal.sentenceEn: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
royal.translationZh: 负责在伦敦西部举办这一年度展会的英国皇家园艺学会(RHS)表示，实施这项禁令是因为塑料草坪对环境和生物多样性造成了破坏。
royal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

royal.sentenceEn: A recent paper, titled "The Natural Selection of Bad Science", published on the Royal Society's open science website, attempts to answer this intriguing and important question.
royal.translationZh: 最近，一篇题为《不良科学的自然选择》的论文发表在英国皇家学会的开放科学网站上，试图回答这个有趣而重要的问题。
royal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

royal.sentenceEn: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients' rights and their expectations of privacy.
royal.translationZh: 正是在这样的背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆对英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）旗下的皇家自由医院信托基金作出了严厉的裁决。该信托基金在2015年依据一项模糊的协议向DeepMind移交了160万患者的病历，而该协议对患者权利及隐私期望的考虑严重不足。
royal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

royal.sentenceEn: Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court, or for the choir boys of St. Paul's and the royal chapel, who, however, gave plays in public as well as at court.
royal.translationZh: 追求文学造诣的戏剧作品当时多为学校、宫廷或圣保罗大教堂与皇家礼拜堂的唱诗班男孩们而作，不过这些唱诗班男孩们不仅在宫廷演出，也会进行公开表演。
royal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

royal.sentenceEn: While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
royal.translationZh: 尽管民意调查显示，英国人将“乡村”与王室、莎士比亚和国民医疗服务体系(NHS)并列为最令他们为国家感到自豪的事物，但这一情感获得的政治支持却十分有限。
royal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

realize.sentenceEn: What was more, many original French dispatches had been preserved in this collection, which I realized was priceless.
realize.translationZh: 更重要的是，这组档案中还保存了许多法国原始公文，我意识到这可是无价之宝。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

realize.sentenceEn: But phones run on batteries, and batteries can die faster than we realize .
realize.translationZh: 但手机需要电池供电，而电池耗尽的速度可能比我们想象的要快。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

realize.sentenceEn: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren't charged it, but most didn't realize they owed it and few paid.
realize.translationZh: 如果商家没有向顾客收取销售税，顾客通常需要自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数人并未意识到自己有此义务，因此很少有人实际缴纳。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

realize.sentenceEn: Half of them found a toy; the other half discovered the container was empty – and realized the tester had fooled them.
realize.translationZh: 其中一半孩子发现了玩具；另一半则发现容器是空的——并意识到测试者欺骗了他们。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

realize.sentenceEn: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
realize.translationZh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

realize.sentenceEn: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
realize.translationZh: 然而，在那门课程学习期间，我意识到自己在这个领域的才华不足以在未来与其他富有创造力的人才竞争，因此我断定这并非我的正确道路。
realize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

reputation.sentenceEn: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
reputation.translationZh: 我们正在通过取消一个舞台、减少表演嘉宾人数以及采取其他削减措施来降低成本。与此同时，我们仍将竭尽全力，确保音乐节一如既往地充满活力，继续支持当地艺术家和商家，并坚守参与者们所期待的柳条公园（Wicker Park）那独特的精神与名声。
reputation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

reputation.sentenceEn: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
reputation.translationZh: 科学家的职业生涯及其所在机构的声誉取决于他们发表论文的数量和声望，但更重要的是这些论文所获得的引用量。
reputation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

reputation.sentenceEn: From then on his sketches, which appeared under the pen name "Boz" in The Evening Chronicle, earned him a modest reputation .
reputation.translationZh: 从那以后，他以“博兹”为笔名在《纪事晚报》上发表的速写为他赢得了小小的名气。

reputation.sentenceEn: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
reputation.translationZh: 唯有女王以其相当亲民（尽管也颇为富足）的祖母形象，维护了君主制的声誉。
reputation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

reputation.sentenceEn: Yet, in several instances, justices acted in ways that weakened the court's reputation for being independent and impartial.
reputation.translationZh: 然而，在若干情况下，大法官的行事方式损害了最高法院独立公正的声誉。
reputation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

reputation.sentenceEn: His reputation as a music critic has long been in dispute.
reputation.translationZh: 他作为音乐评论家的声誉长期以来一直备受争议。

route.sentenceEn: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
route.translationZh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
route.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

route.sentenceEn: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
route.translationZh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
route.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

route.sentenceEn: Contributors offer a wide array of stories, from little-known new shortcuts to long-established alternate routes .
route.translationZh: 贡献者们提供了各种各样的路线故事，从鲜为人知的新捷径到历史悠久的替代路线应有尽有。
route.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

route.sentenceEn: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
route.translationZh: 当欲望小径在现实与虚拟空间中纵横交错，它们成为了集体坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的证明。
route.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

route.sentenceEn: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
route.translationZh: 俄亥俄州立大学允许学生们在校园中心的椭圆形草坪（the Oval）自由穿行，随后学校将这些学生们自然踩出的小径铺设成路，形成了一张由学生自行开辟的高效路线网络。
route.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

route.sentenceEn: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
route.translationZh: 这些由集体“违规”踏出的路径，常常在整齐的绿地中形成一条条被踩出的泥土小径，它们抄近道、横穿草坪、翻越山丘，展现了人类（和动物）以最有效方式从A点到达B点的本能倾向。
route.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

rail.sentenceEn: Since the 2008 launch of the high-speed rail network between Rome and Milan, trains have become the preferred means of travel across Italy for locals and tourists alike.
rail.translationZh: 自2008年罗马至米兰的高铁网络开通以来，火车已成为当地人和游客在意大利境内旅行的首选交通工具。
rail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rail.sentenceEn: This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP.
rail.translationZh: 近期，频繁的维护工程导致了严重的延误。时值大众休假出行的高峰期，这使得铁路行业陷入混乱。对于旅游业贡献了10%国内生产总值的国家而言，这直接影响到了国家的经济。
rail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

rail.sentenceEn: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
rail.translationZh: 此次升级带来的最重要变化之一，是通过建设地下铁路链路，在特定城市中心实现高铁线路与常规线路的分离。
rail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

rail.sentenceEn: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
rail.translationZh: 这已经成了一个令人沮丧却又如期而至的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择、只能依靠铁路通勤上班或出行的人们带来沉重的额外负担。
rail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

rail.sentenceEn: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
rail.translationZh: 铁路运营商又一次提高客运票价，这究竟如何说得过去？
rail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rail.sentenceEn: What is many captive shippers' attitude towards the consolidation in the rail industry?
rail.translationZh: 许多受控制的托运人对铁路行业的整合持何种态度？
rail.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）

reduction.sentenceEn: It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains travelling on the same line at any given time, which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity, according to Giuricin.
reduction.translationZh: 朱里钦表示，这将缩短在同一线路上行驶的高铁列车之间的追踪间隔，意味着运输能力和交通流畅度都将得到显著提升。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

reduction.sentenceEn: Mandatory in-person renewal was associated with a 31 percent reduction in fatal crashes involving drivers 85 or older, according to one study.
reduction.translationZh: 一项研究显示，强制本人到场续领驾照与85岁及以上驾驶员致命车祸减少31%相关。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reduction.sentenceEn: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster—the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
reduction.translationZh: 这一切发生之际，作者们本已在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一家大型出版商西蒙与舒斯特出版社拟议合并可能带来的后果——英国独立出版商数量的减少可能会导致竞价竞争减少、预付款降低，以及出版内容更趋同质化。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

reduction.sentenceEn: "We see that the program is associated with a 30 percent reduction in deforestation," Ferraro says.
reduction.translationZh: 费拉罗表示：“我们发现该计划与森林砍伐率下降30%相关。”
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reduction.sentenceEn: Monitoring is the first step on the road to reduction , but there is much more to be done, and not just by big companies.
reduction.translationZh: 监控是减排道路上的第一步，但仍有更多工作要做，而且不仅仅是大公司的责任。
reduction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reduction.sentenceEn: Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.
reduction.translationZh: 水石书店各分店收入大幅减少。

region.sentenceEn: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
region.translationZh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

region.sentenceEn: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.
region.translationZh: 美国其他地区、加拿大以及欧洲都在稳步加大力度，通过激励措施吸引影视剧组入驻，这使得加利福尼亚州望尘莫及。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

region.sentenceEn: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species.
region.translationZh: 亚洲可以说是在提高恢复多样性和研究本土物种的全球努力中，最被忽视的地区。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

region.sentenceEn: One of the turning points in public support for land conservation efforts—and recognizing the magnificence of the Yellowstone region in particular—came in the form of vivid photographs.
region.translationZh: 公众对土地保护工作的支持，尤其是对黄石地区壮丽景色的认识，其转折点之一便是这些生动的照片。

region.sentenceEn: That's why Hayden's expedition aimed to produce a fuller understanding of the Yellowstone River region , from its hot springs and waterfalls to its variety of flora and fauna.
region.translationZh: 因此，海登的探险队旨在让人们更全面地了解黄石河流域，从那里的温泉、瀑布到丰富多样的动植物。

region.sentenceEn: With the global population predicted to hit close to 10 billion by 2050, and forecasts that agricultural production in some regions will need to nearly double to keep pace, food security is increasingly making headlines.
region.translationZh: 预计到2050年全球人口将接近100亿，而据预测，部分地区的农业产量需接近翻倍才能跟上这一增长步伐，粮食安全问题因此日益成为新闻焦点。
region.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

release.sentenceEn: As the streamers' emphasis changed from subscriber growth to profitability, prices for the services went up and the number of new shows went down to 481 released in 2023, with the number expected to dip into the 300s within a few years.
release.translationZh: 随着流媒体平台的工作重心从用户增长转向盈利，各项服务价格随之上涨，而新剧集的数量在2023年降至481部，预计未来几年内这一数字还将跌破400部。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

release.sentenceEn: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
release.translationZh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

release.sentenceEn: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
release.translationZh: 因此，除非客户愿意签署数据使用授权协议，否则人工智能的应用在未来可能会受到一定限制。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

release.sentenceEn: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release .
release.translationZh: 目前，超过半数的英国科学研究成果是在开放获取条款下发表的：要么自发表之日起即可免费获取，要么设置一年或更长时间的付费墙，以便出版商在全面公开前获取利润。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

release.sentenceEn: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
release.translationZh: 接下来，研究人员将机器人关进笼子，并给老鼠们通过按压杠杆来释放它们的机会。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

release.sentenceEn: India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
release.translationZh: 印度于今年春季发布了其人工智能伦理战略。
release.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

religious.sentenceEn: Offering up such a theory during a time of high tension between scientific and religious minds was branded as heresy and any such heretics that continued to spread these lies were to be punished by imprisonment or even death.
religious.translationZh: 在科学思想与宗教思想关系高度紧张的时期提出这样的理论，被视为异端邪说，而任何继续传播这些'谎言'的异端分子都将面临监禁甚至死刑的惩罚。
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

religious.sentenceEn: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
religious.translationZh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

religious.sentenceEn: "You have the importation of terminology that historically used to be associated with non-profit organizations and religious organizations: terms like vision, values, passion, and purpose," said Khurana.
religious.translationZh: 库拉纳指出：“现在企业引入了一些历史上通常与非营利组织和宗教组织相关联的术语，比如愿景、价值观、激情和目标。”
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

religious.sentenceEn: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection, perhaps the world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
religious.translationZh: 正如人类纷繁复杂的求偶仪式都可被视为性选择的表现形式一样，或许世界上的语言、音乐、社会及宗教习俗乃至历史，都受到某些普遍特征的制约。
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

religious.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's, as one clergyman learned in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion.
religious.translationZh: 与此同时，许多移民的宗教信仰远不如戴恩那般虔诚。正如一位牧师在与沿海居民交流时所了解到的，这些人嘲讽道，他们来新大陆并非为了宗教。
religious.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

religious.sentenceEn: Religious associations began, for example, in the desire to secure the favor of overruling powers and to ward off evil influences; family life in the desire to gratify appetites and secure family perpetuity; systematic labor, for the most part, because of enslavement to others, etc.
religious.translationZh: 例如，宗教团体的起源是为了获得至高无上的神灵庇佑并抵御邪恶影响；家庭生活源于满足欲望和确保家族延续的愿望；系统性劳动在很大程度上则是因为受制于他人，等等。
religious.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
religious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

rental.sentenceEn: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals .
rental.translationZh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
rental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

rental.sentenceEn: Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Hom, an expert on affordable housing policy.
rental.translationZh: 经济适用房政策专家Keren Hom表示，短期租赁本身并非问题的核心。
rental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

rental.sentenceEn: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s.
rental.translationZh: 自21世纪10年代Airbnb等平台兴起以来，新英格兰地区的各个社区就一直在尝试规范短租业务。
rental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rental.sentenceEn: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
rental.translationZh: 在新罕布什尔州，租金空置率已降至1%以下，住房权益倡导者担心，不受监管的短期租赁将给本已紧张的市场带来进一步压力。
rental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

rental.sentenceEn: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations.
rental.translationZh: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和法规时，问题就出现了。
rental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

rental.sentenceEn: Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly.
rental.translationZh: 其出租空置率正在缓慢上升。

revolution.sentenceEn: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
revolution.translationZh: 我们仍处于这场革命的开端，当下的微小选择未来可能会产生巨大的影响。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

revolution.sentenceEn: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
revolution.translationZh: 工业革命对那些工作被机械化织布机取代的卢德派分子来说并不是什么好事，但它最终提高了生活水平，创造的就业机会也多于其摧毁的数量。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

revolution.sentenceEn: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution , but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
revolution.translationZh: 人机对抗这一概念至少可以追溯到工业革命时期，但这种现象在经济下行和复苏乏力时期往往表现得最为尖锐。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

revolution.sentenceEn: The victims of this revolution , of course, are not limited to designers.
revolution.translationZh: 当然，这场变革的受害者远不止设计师。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

revolution.sentenceEn: But the one thing we know for sure is that with each advance in globalization and the I. T. revolution , the best jobs will require workers to have more and better education to make themselves above average.
revolution.translationZh: 但有一点我们可以肯定，随着全球化和信息技术革命的每一次推进，那些最好的工作岗位将要求劳动者接受更多、更好的教育，使自己超越平庸。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

revolution.sentenceEn: Davidson's article is one of a number of pieces that have recently appeared making the point that the reason we have such stubbornly high unemployment and declining middle-class incomes today is largely because of the big drop in demand because of the Great Recession, but it is also because of the advances in both globalization and the information technology revolution , which are more rapidly than ever replacing labor with machines or foreign workers.
revolution.translationZh: 戴维森的文章是近期发表的一系列文章之一，这些文章都阐明了一个观点：如今失业率居高不下、中产阶级收入不断下降，在很大程度上是由于大衰退导致的需求大幅下降，但同时也因为全球化的推进和信息技术革命的发展，这些因素正以前所未有的速度用机器或外国劳动力取代本土劳动力。
revolution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

root.sentenceEn: "They even claimed that plants have 'brain-like command centers' at their root tips."
root.translationZh: 他们甚至声称植物的根尖处存在'类似大脑的指挥中心'。
root.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

root.sentenceEn: The idea that plants have some degree of consciousness first took root in the early 2000s; the term "plant neurobiology" was coined around the notion that some aspects of plant behavior could be compared to intelligence in animals.
root.translationZh: 植物具有某种程度意识的观点最早在21世纪初开始扎根；"植物神经生物学"这一术语的创造正是基于这样一种概念，即植物行为的某些方面可以与动物的智力相比较。
root.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

root.sentenceEn: The drive to discover is deeply rooted in humans, much the same as the basic drives for food or shelter, says Christopher Hsee of the University of Chicago.
root.translationZh: 芝加哥大学的奚恺元表示，人类探索未知的驱动力根深蒂固，与对食物或住所的基本需求大致相同。
root.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

root.sentenceEn: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.
root.translationZh: 然而，科学也拥有其文化历史，其根源可以追溯到文明的曙光时期。
root.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

root.sentenceEn: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social concepts like liberty and property.
root.translationZh: 宪法 law 具有政治性，因为它源于植根于自由和财产等基本社会观念的选择。
root.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

root.sentenceEn: These issues all have root causes in human behavior: all require behavioral change and social innovations, as well as technological development. Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
root.translationZh: 这些问题的根源都在于人类行为：所有问题的解决不仅需要技术发展，还需要行为改变和社会创新。例如，遏制气候变化既要发展清洁能源，也要改变消费模式和提高税收接受度。

railroad.sentenceEn: Your outline should smoothly conduct you from one point to the next, but do not permit it to railroad you.
railroad.translationZh: 你的提纲应当引导你从一个观点自然过渡到下一个观点，但不要让它束缚你的思路。
railroad.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
railroad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

railroad.sentenceEn: Railroads justify rate discrimination against captive shippers on the grounds that in the long run it reduces everyone's cost.
railroad.translationZh: 铁路公司为对受牵制托运商实行差别费率辩解，理由是从长远来看，这会降低所有人的成本。
railroad.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
railroad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

railroad.sentenceEn: But many shippers complain that for heavy bulk commodities traveling long distances, such as coal, chemicals, and grain, trucking is too costly and the railroads therefore have them by the throat.
railroad.translationZh: 但许多托运商抱怨说，对于煤炭、化学品和粮食等长途运输的大宗货物而言，公路运输成本太高，因此铁路公司扼住了他们的咽喉。
railroad.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
railroad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

railroad.sentenceEn: Railroads typically charge such "captive" shippers 20 to 30 percent more than they do when another railroad is competing for the business.
railroad.translationZh: 通常情况下，铁路公司对这些"受牵制的"托运商收取的费用，比有其他铁路公司竞争业务时高出20%至30%。
railroad.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
railroad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

railroad.sentenceEn: As recently as 1995, the top four railroads accounted for under 70 percent of the total ton-miles moved by rails.
railroad.translationZh: 就在1995年，四家最大的铁路公司仅占铁路运输总吨英里数的70%以下。
railroad.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
railroad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

railroad.sentenceEn: The railroad industry as a whole, despite its brightening fortunes, still does not earn enough to cover the cost of the capital it must invest to keep up with its surging traffic.
railroad.translationZh: 尽管铁路行业整体前景向好，但其盈利仍不足以覆盖为应对激增的运输量而必须投入的资本成本。
railroad.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
railroad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

relatively.sentenceEn: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe and 80% are in decline, mostly because intensive chemical farming has reduced many species to tiny fragments of habitat and small nature reserves.
relatively.translationZh: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶物种相对较少，其中80%的物种数量正在下降，这主要是因为集约化的化学农业将许多物种的栖息地缩减为零星的小块区域和小型自然保护区。

relatively.sentenceEn: Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
relatively.translationZh: 到19世纪90年代，抓拍自然流露的笑容已相对容易，因此我们必须从其他方面来解释为什么维多利亚时代的人们仍然不愿在拍照时微笑。
relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

relatively.sentenceEn: Equally, there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
relatively.translationZh: 同样，有一种观点认为，东南部通勤者的艰辛——其中许多人将面临最大幅度的票价上涨——获得的关注过多，而相比之下，中部和北部地区那些必须忍受相对落后基础设施的人们却关注不足。

relatively.sentenceEn: These days, because leisure time is relatively scarce for most workers, people use their free time to counterbalance the intellectual and emotional demands of their jobs.

relatively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

relatively.sentenceEn: Firms seem to invest more in places where most people are relatively happy, rather than in places with happiness inequality.

request.sentenceEn: We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city's largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations.

request.sentenceEn: That helps explain why tip requests are creeping into new kinds of services.

request.sentenceEn: Today's tip requests are often not connected to the salary and service norms that used to determine when and how people tip.
