radical.translationZh: 借用伟大的社会科学家约瑟夫·熊彼特的话来说：没有创造性破坏，就没有根本性创新。
radical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

radical.sentenceEn: The food industry will be alarmed that such senior doctors back such radical moves, especially the call to use some of the tough tactics that have been deployed against smoking over the last decade.
radical.translationZh: 食品行业会对如此资深的医生支持这类激进举措感到震惊，尤其是他们呼吁采用过去十年中用于控烟的部分强硬手段。
radical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

radical.sentenceEn: Mr. McWhorter acknowledges that formal language is not strictly necessary, and proposes no radical education reforms – he is really grieving over the loss of something beautiful more than useful.
radical.translationZh: 麦克沃特先生承认，正式语言并非绝对必要，他也不主张进行激进的教育改革——他真正痛心的是某种美丽事物的消逝，而非实用功能的丧失。
radical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
radical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

radical.sentenceEn: Instead, we are treated to fine hypocritical spectacles, which now more than ever seem in ample supply: the critic of American materialism with a Southampton summer home; the publisher of radical books who takes his meals in three-star restaurants; the journalist advocating participatory democracy in all phases of life, whose own children are enrolled in private schools.
radical.translationZh: 相反，我们却目睹了精心包装的虚伪景象，如今这类景象似乎比以往任何时候都要多：批判美国物质主义的评论家在南安普顿拥有避暑别墅；出版激进书籍的出版商在三星级餐厅享用佳肴；倡导生活各方面践行参与式民主的记者，却将自己的子女送入私立学校。
radical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
radical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

radical.sentenceEn: It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries.
radical.translationZh: 这引发了商业渔业的根本性改革。

react.sentenceEn: They also "appear to be more comfortable writing in role … while [control] pupils imagine how they themselves would react to being shipwrecked, [target] children put themselves in the shoes of a literary character and express that character's emotion".
react.translationZh: 他们也'似乎更擅长角色扮演式写作……当[对照组]学生想象自己遭遇海难会如何反应时，[目标组]儿童则会代入文学角色，表达该角色的情感'。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

react.sentenceEn: A butterfly takes off so quickly it is still impossible to react quickly enough to capture that take-off but if he half-presses the shutter, the camera saves the 70 previous frames before the moment he actually takes the picture.
react.translationZh: 蝴蝶起飞速度极快，快到让人来不及反应捕捉这一起飞瞬间，但如果他半按快门，相机就会保存他实际拍照前的70帧画面。

react.sentenceEn: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
react.translationZh: 此外，当公司将首席执行官的薪酬与（比如说）股价挂钩时，股市会做出积极反应，这表明这些做法不仅为首席执行官个人，也为公司整体创造了价值。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

react.sentenceEn: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
react.translationZh: 在过去十年左右的时间里，技术进步使Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众市场品牌能够更迅速地响应潮流，并更精准地预测需求。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

react.sentenceEn: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
react.translationZh: 快速决策可能是重要的防御机制；当我们判断某人是否具有危险性时，我们的大脑和身体会本能地在几毫秒内做出快速反应。
react.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

react.sentenceEn: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact
react.translationZh: 性格会影响人对眼神接触的反应方式

regulate.sentenceEn: According to our research, 25% have decided to either outright ban AI or regulate its use within their organisations.
regulate.translationZh: 根据我们的研究，25%的受访者已决定在组织内彻底禁止使用人工智能，或对其使用进行规范。
regulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

regulate.sentenceEn: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
regulate.translationZh: 然而，所有这一切在上个月末陷入了巨大的危机——美国最高法院就爱达荷州的一起案件作出裁决，大幅削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)对湿地和水道的监管权。
regulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

regulate.sentenceEn: "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?" Hom said.
regulate.translationZh: 霍姆说：“我认为问题在于，开发商明明是在建造酒店，却把它伪装成非酒店性质的建筑，难道不应该像对待酒店一样对其进行管理、征税和监管吗？”
regulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

regulate.sentenceEn: For AI to be successful, data needs to be accessible, but the use of personal data is becoming more regulated and the automated sharing of data is becoming more difficult.
regulate.translationZh: 要让人工智能取得成功，数据必须易于获取，然而个人数据的使用正受到越来越多的监管，数据的自动共享也变得愈发困难。
regulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

regulate.sentenceEn: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s.
regulate.translationZh: 自21世纪10年代Airbnb等平台兴起以来，新英格兰地区的各个社区就一直在尝试规范短租业务。
regulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

regulate.sentenceEn: The order also declared that state and local governments couldn't regulate broadband providers either.
regulate.translationZh: 该命令还宣布，州和地方政府也不得监管宽带服务提供商。
regulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

retire.sentenceEn: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections".
retire.translationZh: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，水石书店各分店经理接到指示，要求将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍从展台、陈列区和橱窗等显眼位置移走，并将其“悄然归位到相应的分类区域”。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

retire.sentenceEn: Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly, says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (RCE).
retire.translationZh: 荷兰文化遗产局（RCE）的高分子化学家西娅·范·奥斯滕（Thea van Oosten）表示，某些文物特别脆弱，因为塑料艺术的一些先驱者并不总是知道如何正确调配材料。她在该局工作了数十年，于几年前退休。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

retire.sentenceEn: "It's not just a financial decision, but an emotional one. Many people believe they can't retire ."
retire.translationZh: 这不仅仅是一个财务决定，更是一个情感决定。许多人认为自己无法退休。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

retire.sentenceEn: About 72% of "unretiree" respondents said that they would return to work once retired to keep mentally fit while 59% said it would be tied to making ends meet.
retire.translationZh: 约72%的“未退休者”受访者表示，他们退休后会重返工作岗位以保持精神健康，而59%的人则表示这与维持生计有关。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

retire.sentenceEn: Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring —said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
retire.translationZh: 更令人惊讶的是，超过一半的“未退休者”——那些计划退休后继续工作或退休后重返职场的人——表示，即使他们有足够的钱安享晚年，也仍会在晚年继续工作。
retire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

retire.sentenceEn: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?
retire.translationZh: 为何水石书店要将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍移至其相关分类区域？

rival.sentenceEn: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
rival.translationZh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
rival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

rival.sentenceEn: From the early days of broadband, advocates for consumers and web-based companies worried that the cable and phone companies selling broadband connections had the power and incentive to favor affiliated websites over their rivals' .
rival.translationZh: 从宽带发展初期开始，消费者权益倡导者和网络公司就担心，提供宽带连接服务的有线电视和电话公司有能力且有动机偏袒关联网站，而歧视其竞争对手的网站。
rival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rival.sentenceEn: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn't before.
rival.translationZh: 现在，竞争对手也将开始征收此前未征收的销售税。
rival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

rival.sentenceEn: Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment; and no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
rival.translationZh: 宫廷、学校、业余剧团以及巡回演员都竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的广泛需求；任何上过文法学校的男孩都不会不知道，戏剧是一种曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀的文学形式，或许也能为英格兰带来荣誉。
rival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

rival.sentenceEn: Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
rival.translationZh: 后来，更多老牌公司也竞相为自己申请此类专利，哪怕只是为了采取防御措施，以防竞争对手抢占先机。
rival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

routine.sentenceEn: "Tech is designed to really suck you in," says Jenny Radesky in her study of digital play, "and digital products are there to promote maximal engagement. It makes it hard to disengage, and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine ."
routine.translationZh: 詹妮·拉德斯基在其关于数字娱乐的研究中指出：“科技产品的设计初衷就是为了牢牢吸引你的注意力，而数字产品的存在就是为了促使用户尽可能长时间地使用。这使得人们难以从中抽离，并大量渗透到家庭日常生活中。”
routine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

routine.sentenceEn: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing – much like a(n) effective exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.
routine.translationZh: 最重要的是，它会不断调整和改进你所玩的游戏，以巩固你正在培养的能力——这很像一套有效的锻炼方案需要你增加阻力并变换肌肉的使用方式。
routine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

routine.sentenceEn: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as falling outside the boundaries of routine , and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
routine.translationZh: 如今，教授们通常将对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义公共政策视为恰当的研究课题，同时将保守派或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自力更生——描绘成超出常规研究范畴，有时甚至是超出正当学术探讨界限的内容。
routine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

routine.sentenceEn: Cargo aircraft, in contrast, might be easier to reschedule, as might routine military flights.
routine.translationZh: 相比之下，货运飞机或许更容易重新安排时间，常规军事飞行也一样。
routine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

routine.sentenceEn: The companies that Dr. Curtis turned to – Procter & Gamble, Colgate-Palmolive and Unilever – had invested hundreds of millions of dollars finding the subtle cues in consumers' lives that corporations could use to introduce new routines .
routine.translationZh: 柯蒂斯博士所求助的公司——宝洁（Procter & Gamble）、高露洁-棕榄（Colgate-Palmolive）和联合利华（Unilever）——已投入数亿美元，用于发掘消费者生活中的微妙线索，企业可利用这些线索来引入新的生活习惯。
routine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

reasonable.sentenceEn: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
reasonable.translationZh: 相反，假设你提出一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应被迫生活在贫困中。

reasonable.sentenceEn: This would be reasonable if it were not for the fact that scientists can easily arrange to cite themselves in their future publications, or get associates to do so for them in return for similar favours.
reasonable.translationZh: 若不是因为科学家们可以轻易地在自己未来的 publications 中引用自己的研究，或让同事为他们这样做以换取类似的帮助，这种做法本是合理的。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

reasonable.sentenceEn: Then I counter with another reasonable argument: that a higher minimum wage will force businesses to employ fewer people for less time.
reasonable.translationZh: 那么我会用另一个合理的论点反驳：提高最低工资会迫使企业减少雇佣人数、缩短雇佣时间。

reasonable.sentenceEn: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.
reasonable.translationZh: 即将出台的改革可能会使这一价格更趋合理。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

reasonable.sentenceEn: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
reasonable.translationZh: 在面临严重、紧急情况时，他们仍然可以不受第四修正案保护条款的限制，并且可以采取合理措施确保在等待搜查令期间手机数据不会被删除或篡改。
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

reasonable.translationZh: 还有什么比这更合情合理的呢？
reasonable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

reasoning.sentenceEn: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.
reasoning.translationZh: 教育工作者提倡让高中生完成详尽的实验练习，他们认为此类活动的主要益处在于能够增强学生的逻辑推理和观察能力。
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reasoning.sentenceEn: You can say something like, "I know we seem to be moving toward a first-quarter commitment here. I have reasons to think that won't work. I'd like to lay out my reasoning . Would that be OK?"
reasoning.translationZh: 你可以这样说：“我知道我们似乎正准备确定第一季度的任务。但我有理由认为这行不通。我想阐述一下我的理由，可以吗？”
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

reasoning.sentenceEn: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason.
reasoning.translationZh: 当许多人开始肩负起将理性思考与科学哲学融入世界的使命时，文艺复兴时代宣告结束，一个全新的时代——理性时代，已然到来。
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

reasoning.sentenceEn: "We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other's reasoning and each other's conceptions of reason."
reasoning.translationZh: 我们共同推理、相互质疑、修正完善彼此的推理过程以及对理性的理解。
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

reasoning.sentenceEn: On the other hand, he did not accept as well founded the charge made by some of his critics that, while he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning .
reasoning.translationZh: 另一方面，一些批评家指责他虽然善于观察，却缺乏推理能力，他认为这种指责是毫无根据的。
reasoning.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
reasoning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

reasoning.sentenceEn: It is a flawed line of reasoning to argue against returning artifacts to their countries of origin.
reasoning.translationZh: 反对将文物归还给其原产国的论点存在逻辑缺陷。

recovery.sentenceEn: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.
recovery.translationZh: 作为网络运营商，意大利铁路网公司（RFI）是欧洲复苏基金最大的单一受益方，计划到 2026 年投资 240 亿欧元。
recovery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

recovery.sentenceEn: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
recovery.translationZh: 诚然，自2008年全球金融危机以来，经济已出现初步复苏迹象，但在医疗和教育等关键领域的核心指标上，主要经济体却持续下滑。
recovery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

recovery.sentenceEn: When the recovery began, worker shortages first appeared in the high-skilled trades.
recovery.translationZh: 经济复苏开始时，高技能行业首先出现了工人短缺的情况。
recovery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

recovery.sentenceEn: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries .
recovery.translationZh: 人机对抗这一概念至少可以追溯到工业革命时期，但这种现象在经济下行和复苏乏力时期往往表现得最为尖锐。
recovery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

recovery.sentenceEn: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
recovery.translationZh: 随着经济复苏的初步迹象开始显现，公司二把手们可能更愿意在没有找到下家的情况下跳槽。
recovery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

recovery.sentenceEn: The stock market shows signs of recovery .
recovery.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

relate.sentenceEn: Perhaps museums and governments might explore some role for the use of nearly exact reproductions as a means of resolving issues relating to returning works of art and antiquities.
relate.translationZh: 或许博物馆和政府可以探索利用近乎精确的复制品，将其作为解决艺术品和古物返还相关问题的一种途径。
relate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

relate.sentenceEn: Extracurricular activities related to the college major declared on a college application are beneficial, experts suggest.
relate.translationZh: 专家建议，与大学申请中填报的专业相关的课外活动是有益的。
relate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

relate.sentenceEn: "The biggest changes relate to heating and insulation," he explains.
relate.translationZh: 他解释道：“最大的变化涉及供暖和隔热方面。”
relate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

relate.sentenceEn: One idea is that teenage behavior is related to what researchers call "reward sensitivity."
relate.translationZh: 一种观点认为，青少年的行为与研究人员所说的“奖赏敏感性”有关。
relate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

relate.sentenceEn: All good targets should have multiple criteria relating to critical factors such as time, money, quality and customer feedback.
relate.translationZh: 所有良好的目标都应包含与关键因素相关的多重标准，例如时间、成本、质量和客户反馈。
relate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

relate.sentenceEn: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
relate.translationZh: 最高法院的裁决指出，麦克唐纳案的主审法官未能告知陪审团，他们只需考量麦克唐纳的“公务行为”，即这位前州长在与其职责相关的“具体”且“未决”问题上的决策。
relate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

revival.sentenceEn: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
revival.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦伊什表示：“学术界正在重新兴起对愧疚感的研究，或者说重新思考愧疚感是什么以及它能起到什么作用。”她补充道，这种重新审视是人们更广泛认识的一部分——即情绪并非二元对立的，在一种情境中有利的情绪在另一种情境中可能有害。
revival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

revival.sentenceEn: To the horror of some who expected a Greek Revival twin of the Treasury Building to be erected on the other side of the White House, the elaborate French Second Empire style design by Alfred Mullett was selected, and construction of a building to house all three departments began in June of 1871.
revival.translationZh: 一些人原本期待在白宫另一侧建造一座与财政部大楼风格相似的希腊复兴式建筑，然而令他们大跌眼镜的是，阿尔弗雷德·马利特设计的华丽法国第二帝国风格方案最终中标，这座将容纳三个部门的大楼于1871年6月破土动工。

revival.sentenceEn: Is there any chance that Cardus's criticism will enjoy a revival ?
revival.translationZh: 卡德斯的评论还有可能复兴吗？
revival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

revival.sentenceEn: The trouble is that part of the recent acceleration is due to the usual rebound that occurs at this point in a business cycle, and so is not conclusive evidence of a revival in the underlying trend.
revival.translationZh: 问题在于，近期生产力的部分加速增长是由于商业周期中这个阶段通常会出现的反弹，因此并不能作为经济根本趋势复苏的确凿证据。
revival.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
revival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

revival.sentenceEn: Everywhere you go in America, you hear tales of corporate revival .
revival.translationZh: 在美国，无论你走到哪里，都能听到企业复兴的故事。
revival.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
revival.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

revival.sentenceEn: The revival of the economy depends on international cooperation.
revival.translationZh: 经济的复苏取决于国际合作。
revival.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

recall.sentenceEn: When Tom Swetnam joined the U.S. Forest Service in the 1970s, his mandate was to "put everything out," he recalled .
recall.translationZh: 汤姆·斯威特南回想起他在 20 世纪 70 年代加入美国林业局时，得到的指示是“扑灭一切火情”。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

recall.sentenceEn: Perhaps most encouraging of all is a paper from 2022 by researchers at Stanford University that involved a mix of contrived help-seeking interactions and asking people to recall times they'd sought help in the past.
recall.translationZh: 或许最令人鼓舞的是斯坦福大学研究人员2022年发表的一篇论文，该研究结合了人为设计的求助互动实验和要求人们回忆过去求助经历的调查。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

recall.sentenceEn: The latter group made no effort to recall the information when quizzed on it later, because they knew they could find it on their computers.
recall.translationZh: 后者在随后接受测试时并未努力回忆这些信息，因为他们知道可以在电脑上找到。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

recall.sentenceEn: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.
recall.translationZh: 但我们也应当清醒地认识到，这类头衔并非万能良药。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

recall.sentenceEn: I can recall the day my grandfather died and the sadness I felt when we went to the hospital the day before.
recall.translationZh: 我能记起祖父去世那天的情景，以及前一天我们去医院时我感受到的悲伤。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

recall.sentenceEn: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign, which included efforts to engage with consumers directly on sites such as Twitter and the social-news site Digg.
recall.translationZh: 例如，丰田汽车公司在今年早些时候的召回危机中，通过一场相对迅速且精心策划的社交媒体响应活动，减轻了部分损失。该活动包括在Twitter和社交新闻网站Digg等平台上直接与消费者互动。
recall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

recognition.sentenceEn: His status in Lord Wellington's headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.
recognition.translationZh: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及因其工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队中的阶级政治紧密相连。
recognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

recognition.sentenceEn: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
recognition.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦伊什表示：“学术界正在重新兴起对愧疚感的研究，或者说重新思考愧疚感是什么以及它能起到什么作用。”她补充道，这种重新审视是人们更广泛认识的一部分——即情绪并非二元对立的，在一种情境中有利的情绪在另一种情境中可能有害。
recognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

recognition.sentenceEn: Visual recognition , reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
recognition.translationZh: 该研究指出，视觉识别是“一种自动的心理过程，它快速且直观地发生，几乎或完全没有明显的有意识思考”。
recognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

recognition.sentenceEn: For the women of my generation who were urged to keep juggling through the '80s, downshifting in the mid-'90s is not so much a search for the mythical good life—growing your own organic vegetables, and risking turning into one—as a personal recognition of your limitations.
recognition.translationZh: 对于我们这一代在80年代被激励着不停'忙碌人生'的女性来说，90年代中期的'放慢生活节奏'并非追求那种自己种植有机蔬菜、甚至可能变成乡野村夫式的神秘美好生活，而更多是对自身局限的一种个人认知。
recognition.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
recognition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

recruit.sentenceEn: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
recruit.translationZh: 这表明，为日益艰巨的工作岗位招募顶尖人才符合更广泛的企业利益。
recruit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

recruit.sentenceEn: Other industries are recruiting them with similar or better pay.
recruit.translationZh: 其他行业正以相当或更高的薪资招募他们。
recruit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

recruit.sentenceEn: This has created "a paradox" in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that higher education has "continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close" an achievement gap based on social class, according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming in the journal Psychological Science.
recruit.translationZh: 《心理科学》期刊即将发表的一篇论文在开头便揭示了这一令人沮丧的现象：这种做法形成了一个"悖论"——招收第一代大学生，却眼睁睁看着他们中的许多人学业失败，这意味着高等教育"非但没有缩小基于社会阶层的成就差距，反而在持续复制并扩大它"。
recruit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

recruit.sentenceEn: But since such students are most likely to advance economically if they succeed in higher education, colleges and universities have pushed for decades to recruit more of them.
recruit.translationZh: 但由于这类学生若能顺利完成高等教育，他们在经济上取得提升的可能性最大，因此各大高校数十年来一直在努力招收更多这类学生。
recruit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

recruit.sentenceEn: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
recruit.translationZh: 在南非，一项名为“loveLife”的艾滋病预防倡议招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。
recruit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

recruit.sentenceEn: In the case of NBA players, their increase in height appears to result from the increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world.
recruit.translationZh: 就NBA球员而言，他们身高的增长似乎源于从全球各地招募球员这一日益普遍的做法。
recruit.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
recruit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

reference.sentenceEn: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references , do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.
reference.translationZh: 对于希望避开引用操纵集团活动的作者而言：当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求您添加不恰当的参考文献时，请勿照办，并务必向期刊报告这一请求。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

reference.sentenceEn: Nowadays, his reading material has changed from science fiction and reference books: recently, he revealed that he reads at least 50 nonfiction books a year.
reference.translationZh: 如今，他的阅读材料已不再是科幻小说和参考书：最近，他透露自己每年至少阅读50本非虚构类书籍。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reference.sentenceEn: Ideally, different kinds of reading inform each other, and act as useful reference points for and counterbalances to one another.
reference.translationZh: 理想情况下，不同的阅读方式能够相互启发，互为有用的参照点并相互制衡。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

reference.sentenceEn: The survey used by the Labor Department asks people if they worked less than 35 hours in the reference week.
reference.translationZh: 劳工部采用的调查会询问受访者在参考周内的工作时长是否少于35小时。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

reference.sentenceEn: On display here are various fantasy elements whose reference , at some basic level, seems to be the natural world.
reference.translationZh: 在这里呈现的是各种奇幻元素，这些元素在某种基本层面上似乎都指向着自然界。
reference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

reference.sentenceEn: In effect, you try to reconstruct the likely meanings or effects that any given sentence, image or reference might have had: These might be the ones the author intended.
reference.translationZh: 实际上，你会尝试重构任何特定句子、图像或引用可能具有的潜在含义或效果：这些可能就是作者想要表达的。

register.sentenceEn: Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city's Inspectional Services Department.
register.translationZh: 波士顿则更进一步，要求短租房东在该市的检查服务部门进行登记。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

register.sentenceEn: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
register.translationZh: 该法案要求每位民宿房东在州政府登记注册，强制他们购买保险，并在新增的州税基础上为地方税的征收创造了可能性。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

register.sentenceEn: These pauses typically occur at about three per second, and the eyes then jump to another spot, until several important points in the image are registered like a series of snapshots.
register.translationZh: 这些注视停顿通常每秒约三次，随后眼睛会跳转到另一个位置，直到图像中的几个重要点像一系列快照一样被记录下来。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

register.sentenceEn: Only if the jobless arrive at the jobcentre with a CV, register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit – and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly.
register.translationZh: 失业者只有带着简历到就业中心，注册在线求职，并开始寻找工作，才有资格领取救济金——之后他们还需每周汇报一次，而非每两周一次。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

register.sentenceEn: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
register.translationZh: 部长们还应致力于增强租赁市场环境的确定性，这将对注册住房供应商依靠收入为新开发项目融资的能力产生重大影响。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

register.sentenceEn: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
register.translationZh: 对某一产品怀有热情的消费者可能会自愿将其推荐给朋友，从而创造出“口碑媒体”；企业则可以利用“自有媒体”，向其网站的注册用户发送有关产品和促销的电子邮件提醒。
register.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

reliable.sentenceEn: "Machine learning often provides a more reliable form of statistics which makes data more valuable," says Winston.
reliable.translationZh: 温斯顿表示：“机器学习往往能提供更可靠的统计方式，从而提升数据的价值。”
reliable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

reliable.sentenceEn: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
reliable.translationZh: 这已经成了一个令人沮丧却又如期而至的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择、只能依靠铁路通勤上班或出行的人们带来沉重的额外负担。
reliable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

relieve.sentenceEn: On July 29th they were relieved , at least temporarily.
relieve.translationZh: 7月29日，他们如释重负，至少暂时如此。
relieve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

relieve.sentenceEn: The Supreme Court's decisions on physician-assisted suicide carry important implications for how medicine seeks to relieve dying patients of pain and suffering.
relieve.translationZh: 最高法院关于医生协助自杀的裁决，对医学界如何致力于减轻临终患者的痛苦具有重要意义。
relieve.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
relieve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

relieve.sentenceEn: Customers might be relieved of their disasters through lawsuits.
relieve.translationZh: 顾客或许可以通过诉讼获得损失赔偿。
relieve.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）

religion.sentenceEn: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion .
religion.translationZh: 正是这种思维方式导致许多人试图避免争论，尤其是关于政治和宗教的争论。

religion.sentenceEn: Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods – paintings, sculpture and architecture – and superfluous experiences – music, literature, religion and philosophy.
religion.translationZh: 人类的独特之处在于，他们不仅能够制造工具，还能转而使用这些工具创造多余的物质产品——如绘画、雕塑和建筑——以及多余的精神体验——如音乐、文学、宗教和哲学。
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

religion.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's, as one clergyman learned in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion .
religion.translationZh: 与此同时，许多移民的宗教信仰远不如戴恩那般虔诚。正如一位牧师在与沿海居民交流时所了解到的，这些人嘲讽道，他们来新大陆并非为了宗教。
religion.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

religion.sentenceEn: Roman Catholicism had been the state religion and the only one allowed by the Spanish crown.
religion.translationZh: 罗马天主教曾是西班牙王室定立的国教，也是唯一允许存在的宗教。
religion.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

religion.sentenceEn: On the issue of freedom of religion and the position of the Church, however, there was less agreement among the leadership.
religion.translationZh: 然而，在宗教自由和教会地位的问题上，领导层内部却存在较少共识。
religion.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
religion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

religion.sentenceEn: Religion once functioned as a reminder of misery.
religion.translationZh: 宗教曾经起到提醒人们苦难存在的作用。
religion.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

reluctant.sentenceEn: And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
reluctant.translationZh: 而死气沉沉的市场在一定程度上反映了银行的瘫痪状态：它们因担心记录损失而不愿出售资产，同时又不愿购买那些所谓的便宜货。
reluctant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

reluctant.sentenceEn: So when one monkey was handed a grape in exchange for her token, the second was reluctant to hand hers over for a mere piece of cucumber.
reluctant.translationZh: 因此，当一只猴子用代币换到一颗葡萄时，另一只猴子就不愿意用自己的代币只换取一片黄瓜了。
reluctant.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
reluctant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reluctant.sentenceEn: pupils may be reluctant to work on other old dramatists
reluctant.translationZh: 学生们可能不愿学习其他老一辈剧作家的作品

remind.sentenceEn: To overcome these difficulties, try to remind yourself that everyone needs help sometimes.
remind.translationZh: 要克服这些困难，试着提醒自己：每个人有时都需要帮助。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

remind.sentenceEn: The action will remind you of the joy the activity brought you and prime your muscles for when you can get out there again.
remind.translationZh: 这些动作会让你想起这项运动曾带给你的快乐，并为肌肉做好准备，以便你能再次回到运动场上。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第5句

remind.sentenceEn: Remind the person that this is your point of view, and then invite critique.
remind.translationZh: 提醒对方这只是你的个人观点，然后主动邀请对方提出批评意见。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第5句

remind.sentenceEn: Parents need to remind their children that their needs and desires may change over time, said Julie Gurner, a real estate analyst with FitSmallBusiness.com.
remind.translationZh: FitSmallBusiness.com的房地产分析师朱莉·古纳表示，父母需要提醒孩子，他们的需求和愿望可能会随着时间的推移而改变。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第14段，第1句

remind.sentenceEn: He reminds himself that not every lecture can be a Nobel winner; some will be less effective than others.
remind.translationZh: 他提醒自己，并非每一场演讲都能达到诺贝尔奖级别的水准；有些演讲的效果会不如其他场次。
remind.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

remind.sentenceEn: Remind its users to obey existing rules.
remind.translationZh: 提醒其用户遵守现有规则。

restriction.sentenceEn: In the information era, large data sets, small teams and financial restrictions have slowed scientific process.
restriction.translationZh: 在信息时代，庞大的数据集、小型团队和资金限制减缓了科学进程。
restriction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

restriction.sentenceEn: Thomas Goodman, of MyJobQuote, says this will bring in new restrictions for extensions.
restriction.translationZh: MyJobQuote网站的托马斯·古德曼表示，这将为房屋扩建带来新的限制。
restriction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

restriction.sentenceEn: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, "school streets", even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
restriction.translationZh: 限制高污染车辆进入特定区域——市中心、"学校街道"乃至个别路段——是对缺乏更大力度举措的一种回应，这些本应有的举措包括恰当执行现有法规，以及要求汽车公司使其车辆符合标准。
restriction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

restriction.sentenceEn: Madrid was hailed as a public health beacon last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.
restriction.translationZh: 去年11月，马德里因对污染最严重的汽车实施大刀阔斧的限制措施而被誉为公共卫生的典范。
restriction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

restriction.sentenceEn: Stephenson suggested potential restrictions could include banning TV advertisements for foods high in fat, salt or sugar before 9 p.m. and limiting them on billboards or in cinemas.
restriction.translationZh: 斯蒂芬森建议，可能的限制措施可以包括：晚上9点前禁止播放高脂肪、高盐或高糖食品的电视广告，并限制此类广告在广告牌或电影院的投放。
restriction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

restriction.sentenceEn: But NBAC members are planning to word the recommendation narrowly to avoid new restrictions on research that involves the cloning of human DNA or cells—routine in molecular biology.
restriction.translationZh: 但是NBAC成员计划对建议的措辞进行严格限定，以避免对涉及克隆人类DNA或细胞的研究施加新的限制——这类研究在分子生物学中属于常规操作。
restriction.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
restriction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

retail.sentenceEn: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
retail.translationZh: 零售贸易组织对这一裁决表示赞赏，称其为本地企业和在线企业创造了公平的竞争环境。
retail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

retail.sentenceEn: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
retail.translationZh: 零售分析师尼尔·桑德斯表示，输家是那些纯在线零售商，尤其是规模较小的商家。
retail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

retail.sentenceEn: For example, wholesale food and drink sales came to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000 – more than 40 percent of retail sales.
retail.translationZh: 例如，2000年法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国的食品饮料批发销售额达到2680亿美元，超过零售销售额的40%。

retail.sentenceEn: This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent.
retail.translationZh: 这一发展使得整个欧洲餐饮服务领域的批发需求以每年4%至5%的速度增长，相比之下，零售需求的增长率仅为1%至2%。

retail.sentenceEn: Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail ; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
retail.translationZh: 此外，批发业务的平均整体利润率高于零售业务；随着越来越多的欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，食品服务行业的批发需求正在快速增长；而这个分散行业的竞争动态变化最终使批发商整合成为可能。

retail.sentenceEn: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe's largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow.
retail.translationZh: 在欧洲最大的市场上，食品和饮料的零售销售陷入停滞，这使得欧洲食品杂货零售商迫切渴望增长机会。

reverse.sentenceEn: Brexit is seen by some as an opportunity to reverse a recent trend towards the UK importing food.
reverse.translationZh: 一些人将英国脱欧视为扭转英国近期食品进口趋势的契机。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

reverse.sentenceEn: For example, Business Week predicted in 1975 that electronic means of payment would soon "revolutionize the very concept of money itself," only to reverse itself several years later.
reverse.translationZh: 例如，《商业周刊》在1975年曾预测，电子支付方式很快将“彻底改变货币本身的概念”，然而几年后却推翻了这一预测。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

reverse.sentenceEn: Yet we can reverse such influences.
reverse.translationZh: 然而，我们可以扭转这种影响。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reverse.sentenceEn: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
reverse.translationZh: 我们仍然拥有富有想象力的能力去超越诱惑，并扭转这种高速的趋势。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

reverse.sentenceEn: In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms.
reverse.translationZh: 经济史学家本杰明·弗里德曼在其著作《经济增长的道德后果》中指出，无论是在美国国内还是国外，长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总会使社会变得更加心胸狭隘、包容性更低，并且往往会阻碍或逆转权利与自由的进步。
reverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reverse.sentenceEn: The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
reverse.translationZh: 联网计算机提供了50年来第一个逆转这种流向的机会，它鼓励经过思考的下载，更重要的是，鼓励有意义的上传。

regulatory.sentenceEn: This narrowing of the regulatory scope was a victory for builders, mining operators and other commercial interests often at odds with environmental rules.
regulatory.translationZh: 监管范围的这种缩小对建筑商、采矿运营商以及其他常常与环境法规存在冲突的商业利益集团而言是一场胜利。
regulatory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

regulatory.sentenceEn: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
regulatory.translationZh: 从根本上讲，美国邮政署正处于历史性的双重挤压之中：一方面是技术变革永久性地降低了对其核心产品——一类邮件的需求，另一方面是监管结构剥夺了管理层调整业务以适应新现实的灵活性。
regulatory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

regulatory.sentenceEn: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered," a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
regulatory.translationZh: 他们曾力促该机构将这种鸟类列为“濒危物种”——这一 status 赋予联邦官员更大的监管权力以打击威胁。
regulatory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

regulatory.sentenceEn: But as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews the company's application, it should keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth.
regulatory.translationZh: 但当美国核管理委员会（NRC）审核该公司的申请时，应当考虑安特吉公司的承诺究竟有多少可信度。
regulatory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

regulatory.sentenceEn: The legal issues in the case are obscure: whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
regulatory.translationZh: 此案涉及的法律问题晦涩复杂：尽管最高法院已裁定各州确实对核能拥有一定的监管权，但法律学者表示，佛蒙特州这起案件将成为一个开创先例的测试，检验这些权力究竟能延伸到何种程度。
regulatory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

regulatory.sentenceEn: Now the company is suddenly claiming that the 2002 agreement is invalid because of the 2006 legislation, and that only the federal government has regulatory power over nuclear issues.
regulatory.translationZh: 如今该公司突然宣称，由于2006年的立法，2002年的协议无效，并且只有联邦政府对核问题拥有监管权。
regulatory.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

reliance.sentenceEn: Much more needs to be invested in communities and primary care to reduce our reliance on hospitals.
reliance.translationZh: 我们需要在社区和初级医疗方面加大投入，以减少对医院的依赖。
reliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

reliance.sentenceEn: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
reliance.translationZh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
reliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

reliance.sentenceEn: "There may be costs associated with our increased reliance on the Internet, but I'd have to imagine that overall the benefits are going to outweigh those costs," observes psychology professor Benjamin Storm.
reliance.translationZh: 心理学教授本杰明·斯托姆指出：“我们对互联网的依赖加深可能会带来一些代价，但我认为总体而言，其益处将超过这些代价。”
reliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

reliance.sentenceEn: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
reliance.translationZh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校2014年在澳大利亚、英国和美国开展的一项调查发现，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖提高了他们的政治参与度。
reliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reliance.sentenceEn: American papers have long been highly unusual in their reliance on ads.
reliance.translationZh: 长期以来，美国报业对广告的过度依赖显得极不寻常。
reliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reliance.sentenceEn: While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly, there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
reliance.translationZh: 尽管法律新闻报道的质量参差不齐，但许多记者却过度依赖律师提供的解读。
reliance.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
reliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

remark.sentenceEn: "It's a really hard thing to do and it's a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business," Peretti remarked .
remark.translationZh: 佩雷蒂表示：“这确实是一件棘手的事，而BuzzFeed没有传统业务包袱，这实在是一种巨大的优势。”
remark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

remark.sentenceEn: If you are part of the group which you are addressing, you will be in a position to know the experiences and problems which are common to all of you and it'll be appropriate for you to make a passing remark about the inedible canteen food or the chairman's notorious bad taste in ties.
remark.translationZh: 如果你是与你交谈的群体中的一员，你就能了解你们所有人共同的经历和问题，这时你可以随口评论一下食堂难以下咽的饭菜，或者董事长出了名的领带品味差。
remark.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
remark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

remark.sentenceEn: Include a few casual and apparently off-the-cuff remarks which you can deliver in a relaxed and unforced manner.
remark.translationZh: 你可以加入一些随意且看似即兴的话语，以轻松自然的方式表达出来。
remark.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
remark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

remark.sentenceEn: Often it's the delivery which causes the audience to smile, so speak slowly and remember that a raised eyebrow or an unbelieving look may help to show that you are making a light-hearted remark .
remark.translationZh: 往往是表达方式让听众发笑，因此说话要慢一点，并且记住，扬一扬眉毛或露出一副难以置信的表情，可能会有助于表明你正在做轻松愉快的评论。
remark.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
remark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

remark.sentenceEn: With other audiences you mustn't attempt to cut in with humor as they will resent an outsider making disparaging remarks about their canteen or their chairman.
remark.translationZh: 而对于其他听众，你千万不要试图贸然插入幽默，因为他们会反感一个外人对他们的食堂或主席发表贬低性评论。
remark.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
remark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

remark.sentenceEn: remarks that significant moves may pose challenges to children.
remark.translationZh: 称重大搬家可能给孩子带来困难

reminder.sentenceEn: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states.
reminder.translationZh: 这也提醒我们，长期以来，美国环保署参与切萨皮克湾项目至关重要，因为它是超越邻州财力雄厚的特殊利益集团影响的重要手段。
reminder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

reminder.sentenceEn: Madrid's back and forth on clean air is a pointed reminder of the limits to the patchwork, city-by-city approach that characterises efforts on air pollution across Europe, Britain very much included.
reminder.translationZh: 马德里在清洁空气问题上的反复无常，尖锐地提醒人们这种拼凑式、逐城推进的方法存在局限性——这正是全欧洲（英国也概莫能外）应对空气污染努力的特点。
reminder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

reminder.sentenceEn: Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
reminder.translationZh: 英国的新规提醒银行家们，社会关注的是他们的业绩表现，不仅是短期的，更是长期的。
reminder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

reminder.sentenceEn: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.
reminder.translationZh: 埃及航空804航班可能遭到恐怖分子劫持并坠入地中海，这一悲剧再次提醒人们为何要采取这些措施。
reminder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

reminder.sentenceEn: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
reminder.translationZh: 长期以来，一小群直言不讳的夏威夷人和环保人士将这些望远镜的存在视为对圣地的亵渎，也是对这片曾经主权国家被占领历史的痛苦 reminder。
reminder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

reminder.sentenceEn: Religion once functioned as a reminder of misery.
reminder.translationZh: 宗教曾经起到提醒人们苦难存在的作用。
reminder.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

restrict.sentenceEn: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
restrict.translationZh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

restrict.sentenceEn: This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib – a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
restrict.translationZh: 这显然就是麦当劳限制其人气产品McRib（麦辣猪排堡）供应的原因——这一营销手段已将这款猪肉三明治变成了令人痴迷的对象。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

restrict.sentenceEn: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
restrict.translationZh: 批评者对基因专利提出了三个主要反对理由：基因是自然产物，因此不应被授予专利；基因专利会抑制而非奖励创新；专利垄断会限制人们获取像Myriad公司这样的基因检测服务。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

restrict.sentenceEn: But senior medical figures want to stop fast-food outlets opening near schools, restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt or sugar, and limit sponsorship of sports events by fast-food producers such as McDonald's.
restrict.translationZh: 但是资深医学界人士希望阻止快餐店在学校附近开设，限制高脂肪、高盐或高糖产品的广告，并限制快餐生产商（如麦当劳）对体育赛事的赞助。
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

restrict.sentenceEn: The Internet – and pressure from funding agencies, who are questioning why commercial publishers are making money from government-funded research by restricting access to it – is making free access to scientific results a reality.
restrict.translationZh: 互联网的发展，以及来自资助机构的压力——这些机构质疑商业出版商为何通过限制获取渠道，从政府资助的研究中牟利——正使免费获取科研成果成为现实。
restrict.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
restrict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

restrict.sentenceEn: Urge legislation to restrict its use.

retain.sentenceEn: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
retain.translationZh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
retain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

retain.sentenceEn: Together, we are calling for a much more open and honest conversation about the future of health in the UK, and an "urgent rethink" of the hospital-centric model we retain .
retain.translationZh: 我们共同呼吁就英国医疗卫生的未来开展更加开放和坦诚的对话，并“紧急反思”我们目前仍在沿用的以医院为中心的模式。
retain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

retain.sentenceEn: Each spouse retains whatever property he or she brought into the marriage, and jointly-acquired property is divided equally.
retain.translationZh: 夫妻双方各自保留婚前带入婚姻的所有财产，婚后共同获得的财产则平均分配。
retain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

retain.sentenceEn: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
retain.translationZh: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村协调性，同时又能维持低密度的城市生活。
retain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

retain.sentenceEn: The Labour party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition's spending plans if it returns to power.
retain.translationZh: 工党最近宣布，如果重新执政，将保留联合政府的大部分支出计划。
retain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

retain.translationZh: 他们的工程师团队留了下来

rarely.sentenceEn: Although we try our best, sometimes our paintings rarely turn out as originally planned.
rarely.translationZh: 尽管我们竭尽全力，但有时画作很少能如最初设想的那样呈现出来。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

rarely.sentenceEn: And a survey conducted for BuzzFeed News found 44 percent of Facebook users rarely or never trust news from the media giant.
rarely.translationZh: 此外，为BuzzFeed新闻网开展的一项调查发现，44%的Facebook用户很少或从不信任这家媒体巨头发布的新闻。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

rarely.sentenceEn: Many of the ships were lost in storms, many passengers died of disease, and infants rarely survived the journey.
rarely.translationZh: 许多船只在风暴中失事，许多乘客死于疾病，婴儿则很少能在旅途中存活。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

rarely.sentenceEn: Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
rarely.translationZh: 贝多芬习惯将音量增强到极致强度，然后突然转入一段轻柔的乐段，这种手法在他之前的作曲家作品中极为罕见。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

rarely.sentenceEn: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
rarely.translationZh: 不幸福的父母很少会去反思自己当初是否不该要孩子，但不幸福的无子女者却总会被这样的观念所困扰：孩子是世界上最重要的东西。显然，他们的痛苦必定是生活中那个巨大的、婴儿大小的空洞直接造成的后果。
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

rarely.sentenceEn: Growth, which rarely continues beyond the age of 20, demands calories and nutrients – notably, protein – to feed expanding tissues.
rarely.translationZh: 人体的生长发育很少会持续到20岁以后，这一过程需要热量和营养物质——尤其是蛋白质——来滋养不断生长的组织。
rarely.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
rarely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

realistic.sentenceEn: Be optimistic but realistic , and you will stand out.
realistic.translationZh: 保持乐观但也要务实，这样你就能脱颖而出。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第4句

realistic.sentenceEn: Those realistic possibilities are highlighted in the study presented by David Graddol.
realistic.translationZh: 大卫·格拉多尔（David Graddol）的研究报告凸显了这些现实可能性。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

realistic.sentenceEn: According to Ben-Shahar, realistic optimists are those who make the best of things that happen, but not those who believe everything happens for the best.
realistic.translationZh: 本-沙哈尔认为，现实的乐观主义者是那些能充分利用所发生事情的人，而不是那些相信一切事情都会往最好方向发展的人。
realistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

realistic.sentenceEn: They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.
realistic.translationZh: 他们往往会更紧地攥紧钱包，并认为在家就餐是一个现实的替代选择。

realistic.sentenceEn: The goals of researchers ought to be realistic .
realistic.translationZh: 研究人员的目标应当切合实际。

regulator.sentenceEn: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level.
regulator.translationZh: 立法者和监管机构正逐步开始着手解决暗模式相关的模糊地带问题，最近的行动主要在州一级展开。
regulator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

regulator.sentenceEn: Although only a research project at this stage, the request has raised the prospect of regulators wading into early-stage tech markets that until now have been beyond their reach.
regulator.translationZh: 尽管目前这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已经引发了监管机构介入早期科技市场的可能性，而这些市场此前一直是他们难以触及的领域。
regulator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

regulator.sentenceEn: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks.
regulator.translationZh: 英国金融监管机构对大型银行的高管们实施了一项颇为不同寻常的规定。
regulator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

regulator.sentenceEn: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
regulator.translationZh: 法律行业内部存在要求变革的压力，但监管机构中的反对变革者坚持认为，不让外部人士涉足律师事务所，可以使律师免受只顾赚钱而不是以道德方式为客户服务的压力。
regulator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

regulator.sentenceEn: As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to seek permission from state regulators to operate past 2012.
regulator.translationZh: 作为获得州政府批准该交易的条件，该公司同意在2012年后继续运营需获得州监管机构的许可。
regulator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

regulator.sentenceEn: These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
regulator.translationZh: 这些规则要求银行必须按照第三方愿意支付的价格来评估某些资产，而非按照管理层和监管机构期望这些资产能够卖出的价格。
regulator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

relative.sentenceEn: FaceTime with a relative as you strength train or stretch at home.
relative.translationZh: 在家进行力量训练或拉伸时，可以和亲戚进行FaceTime视频通话。
relative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第5句

relative.sentenceEn: It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy.
relative.translationZh: 虽然说出来可能不太受欢迎，但他们薪酬大幅上涨的一个原因是，相较于美国经济中的许多其他劳动者，首席执行官们确实提升了自己的能力。
relative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

relative.sentenceEn: If left to themselves, such trends will diminish the relative strength of the English language in international education markets as the demand for educational resources in languages, such as Spanish, Arabic or Mandarin grows and international business process outsourcing in other languages such as Japanese, French and German, spreads.
relative.translationZh: 如果任其发展，随着西班牙语、阿拉伯语或汉语普通话等语言的教育资源需求不断增长，以及日语、法语和德语等其他语言的国际业务流程外包不断扩展，这些趋势将削弱英语在国际教育市场的相对优势。
relative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

relative.sentenceEn: This doesn't, however, make interpretation merely relative or even pointless.
relative.translationZh: 然而，这并不意味着解读仅仅是相对的，甚至是毫无意义的。
relative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

relative.sentenceEn: If you have no friends or relatives , try to participate in several online communities, full of people who are always willing to share advice and encouragement.
relative.translationZh: 如果你没有朋友或亲戚，可以尝试加入一些在线社区，那里满是愿意分享建议和给予鼓励的人。
relative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第4句

relative.sentenceEn: Washington, who had begun to believe that all men were created equal after observing the bravery of the black soldiers during the Revolutionary War, overcame the strong opposition of his relatives to grant his slaves their freedom in his will.
relative.translationZh: 华盛顿在独立战争期间目睹了黑人士兵的英勇表现后，开始相信人人生而平等。他不顾亲属的强烈反对，在遗嘱中赋予了他的奴隶们自由。
relative.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
relative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

renewable.sentenceEn: Every day, scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways to exploit renewable energy sources and develop techniques not just to use power more intelligently but to power our intelligence.
renewable.translationZh: 每天，科学家、技术专家和工程师都在探索利用可再生能源的新方法，并开发相关技术——不仅是为了更智能地使用能源，也是为了用能源驱动我们的智能发展。
renewable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

renewable.sentenceEn: The move to renewables is picking up momentum around the world: They now account for more than half of new power sources going on line.
renewable.translationZh: 全球向可再生能源转型的势头日益强劲：目前，可再生能源已占新增发电装机容量的一半以上。
renewable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

renewable.sentenceEn: While fossil fuels – coal, oil, gas – still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
renewable.translationZh: 虽然化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍占全球能源供应的约85%，但未来属于风能和太阳能等可再生能源这一点比以往任何时候都更加明确。
renewable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

renewable.sentenceEn: But increasingly the story is about the plummeting prices of renewables , especially wind and solar.
renewable.translationZh: 但如今，越来越重要的原因是可再生能源价格的暴跌，尤其是风能和太阳能。
renewable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

renewable.sentenceEn: While there's a long way to go, the trend lines for renewables are spiking.
renewable.translationZh: 尽管仍有很长的路要走，但可再生能源的发展趋势正在飙升。
renewable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

renewable.sentenceEn: In many parts of the world renewable energy is already a principal energy source.
renewable.translationZh: 在世界许多地区，可再生能源已成为主要能源来源。
renewable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: The residents help to look after the children, an arrangement akin to alloparenting.
resident.translationZh: 养老院的老人们帮忙照看孩子，这一安排类似于“异亲抚育”。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

resident.sentenceEn: The national parks provide great value to U.S. residents both as places to escape and as symbols of nature.
resident.translationZh: 国家公园为美国民众提供了巨大价值，既是休闲避难之所，也是自然的象征。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: In 2007, Indonesia started phasing in a program that gives money to its poorest residents under certain conditions, such as requiring people to keep kids in school or get regular medical care.
resident.translationZh: 2007年，印度尼西亚开始逐步实施一项计划，在特定条件下向最贫困的居民提供资金，例如要求人们让孩子上学或接受定期医疗保健。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.
resident.translationZh: 面对这一严重威胁，地方官员正利用手中一切可用的手段来保障居民的健康。
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

resident.sentenceEn: The worthy residents of Stratford doubt that the theater adds a penny to their revenue.
resident.translationZh: 斯特拉特福那些可敬的居民们认为，剧院没给他们增加一分钱的收入。
resident.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

resident.sentenceEn: Then residents in these communities were phoned at random and asked the same questions.
resident.translationZh: 然后随机打电话给这些社区的居民，询问他们同样的问题。
resident.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
resident.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

resistance.sentenceEn: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing – much like a(n) effective exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.
resistance.translationZh: 最重要的是，它会不断调整和改进你所玩的游戏，以巩固你正在培养的能力——这很像一套有效的锻炼方案需要你增加阻力并变换肌肉的使用方式。
resistance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

resistance.sentenceEn: The subtle and intelligent little book The Marketplace of Ideas: Reform and Resistance in the American University should be read by every student thinking of applying to take a doctoral degree.
resistance.translationZh: 《思想市场：美国大学的改革与抵制》这本精妙而睿智的小书，值得每一位考虑申请攻读博士学位的学生一读。

resistance.sentenceEn: The upwash experience may save propelling energy as well as reducing resistance .
resistance.translationZh: 处于上升气流中的飞行体验既可以节省推进能量，也能减少阻力。

resistance.sentenceEn: Quebec's resistance to a national agency is provincialist ideology. One of the first advocates for a national list was a researcher at Laval University. Quebec's Drug Insurance Fund has seen its costs skyrocket with annual increases from 14.3 per cent to 26.8 per cent!
resistance.translationZh: 魁北克省对国家机构的抵制是地方主义意识形态的体现。最早倡导建立全国药品清单的人士之一是拉瓦尔大学的一名研究人员。魁北克省的药品保险基金成本飙升，年增长率从14.3%攀升至26.8%！
resistance.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

resolve.sentenceEn: Perhaps museums and governments might explore some role for the use of nearly exact reproductions as a means of resolving issues relating to returning works of art and antiquities.
resolve.translationZh: 或许博物馆和政府可以探索利用近乎精确的复制品，将其作为解决艺术品和古物返还相关问题的一种途径。
resolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

resolve.sentenceEn: Mental health is the source of creativity for solving problems, resolving conflict, making our surroundings more beautiful, managing our home life, or coming up with a creative business idea or invention to make our lives easier.
resolve.translationZh: 心理健康是解决问题、化解冲突、美化环境、经营家庭生活的创造力源泉，也是提出创意商业构想或发明来简化我们生活的灵感所在。
resolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

resolve.sentenceEn: They should also learn how to solve problems and resolve conflicts, ways to brainstorm and think critically.
resolve.translationZh: 他们还应该学会如何解决问题、化解冲突，以及如何集思广益和进行批判性思考。
resolve.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
resolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

resolve.sentenceEn: Until these issues are resolved , a technology of behavior will continue to be rejected, and with it possibly the only way to solve our problems.
resolve.translationZh: 在这些问题得到解决之前，行为技术将继续遭到拒绝，而解决我们问题的唯一途径也可能随之被拒之门外。
resolve.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
resolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第16句

resolve.sentenceEn: Hot spots, anchored in the deeper layers of the earth, provide the measuring instruments needed to resolve the question.
resolve.translationZh: 位于地球更深层的热点提供了解决这一问题所需的测量工具。
resolve.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
resolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

resolve.sentenceEn: Proper, scientific study of the impacts of dams and of the cost and benefits of controlling water can help to resolve these conflicts.
resolve.translationZh: 对水坝影响以及治水成本与效益进行恰当的科学研究，有助于解决这些冲突。
resolve.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
resolve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

reviewer.sentenceEn: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer , or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.
reviewer.translationZh: 对于希望避开引用操纵集团活动的作者而言：当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求您添加不恰当的参考文献时，请勿照办，并务必向期刊报告这一请求。
reviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

reviewer.sentenceEn: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers .
reviewer.translationZh: 期刊内部编辑、现有评审编辑委员会或外部同行评审员将标记出需要额外审查的稿件。
reviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

reviewer.sentenceEn: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process".
reviewer.translationZh: 他在2012年撰文指出，研究人员应提高自身标准，而期刊也应采取更严格的措施，“聘请具备统计素养的评审人员和能够验证这一过程的编辑”。
reviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

reviewer.sentenceEn: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
reviewer.translationZh: 在科学界复杂的社会结构中，研究者做出发现；编辑和评审人员通过控制发表流程扮演着守门人的角色；其他科学家则利用这一新发现来满足自身需求；最终，公众（包括其他科学家）接收这一新发现及其可能随之而来的技术。
reviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

reviewer.sentenceEn: Car and film reviewers have gone.
reviewer.translationZh: 汽车和电影评论员已经不复存在。
reviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

reviewer.sentenceEn: Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about.
reviewer.translationZh: 他们从事的是严肃的工作，即便是像萧伯纳和欧内斯特·纽曼这样看似轻松挥洒才学的评论家，也都深谙自己的专业领域。
reviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

ritual.sentenceEn: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual : every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
ritual.translationZh: 这已经成了一个令人沮丧却又如期而至的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择、只能依靠铁路通勤上班或出行的人们带来沉重的额外负担。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

ritual.sentenceEn: There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work – be it lengthy retreats dedicated to a specific task; developing a daily ritual ; or taking a "journalistic" approach to seizing moments of deep work when you can throughout the day.
ritual.translationZh: 掌握深度工作的艺术有多种方法——可以是为特定任务进行长时间的专注工作；培养日常工作习惯；或者采取一种“新闻式”的方法，在一天中随时抓住可以进行深度工作的时刻。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ritual.sentenceEn: Parts of the ceremony involve ritual hair cutting, tying cotton threads soaked in holy water around the bride's and groom's wrists, and passing a candle around a circle of happily married and respected couples to bless the union.
ritual.translationZh: 婚礼的部分仪式包括象征性的剪发、将浸泡过圣水的棉线系在新郎新娘的手腕上，以及让一圈婚姻幸福且受人尊敬的夫妇传递蜡烛，以祝福这对新人的结合。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

ritual.sentenceEn: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection, perhaps the world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
ritual.translationZh: 正如人类纷繁复杂的求偶仪式都可被视为性选择的表现形式一样，或许世界上的语言、音乐、社会及宗教习俗乃至历史，都受到某些普遍特征的制约。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

ritual.sentenceEn: School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual .
ritual.translationZh: 全美各地的学区，最近包括洛杉矶联合学区，都在重新审视这种教育惯例。
ritual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

ritual.sentenceEn: They also focused on important rituals that appeared to preserve a people's social structure, such as initiation ceremonies that formally signify children's entrance into adulthood.
ritual.translationZh: 他们还关注那些似乎维系着一个民族社会结构的重要仪式，例如标志着儿童正式成年的成人礼。
ritual.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

ruin.sentenceEn: It is believed that around 12,000 to 15,000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, although only about 3,000 are known to remain today, many of which are in ruins .
ruin.translationZh: 据信，丝绸之路沿线曾修建了约12,000至15,000座商队驿站，然而如今已知仅存约3,000座，其中许多已是断壁残垣。
ruin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

ruin.sentenceEn: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.
ruin.translationZh: 而过分强调他们的意见可能会毁掉一笔极好的购房交易。
ruin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

ruin.sentenceEn: We do not ruin urban conservation areas.
ruin.translationZh: 我们不会破坏城市保护区。
ruin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第8句

ruin.translationZh: 那为何要毁掉乡村的呢？
ruin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第9句

ruin.sentenceEn: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.
ruin.translationZh: 其目的在于通过毁掉他人生活来追求发行量和影响力。
ruin.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句
